Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Generosity endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his valiant struggle to protect the land from TDs, emptied his own coffers and called upon the people to donate. The gathered wealth was displayed in the <color=Highlight>cottage by the windmill</color> and used to fortify defenses which, at only a modest cost, repelled the TD assault.
In giving, one finds reward.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Wisdom endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon", in his time, devoted himself to the study of the knightly path in <color=Highlight>Silver Moon Grove</color>. Over the years, he wrote volumes on what he learned, so that future knights might follow his teachings.
To the wise, fate serves; to the foolish, fate rules.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Courage endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon," in his youth, singlehandedly fought a victorious battle against an entire pack of ferocious TDs near <color=Highlight>the great tree to the northwest of Egla Town</color>.
Courage is the knight's final weapon.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Mercy endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once stood vigil to <color=Highlight>the west of Mistveil Bay</color>, guarding the merchants who passed through. There, he drove away the fierce TDs and vanquished the ruthless Alari family.
To show mercy to the innocent, one must be merciless to the wicked.

Let this pedestal stand as a testament!
Here, the Knightly Virtue of Honor endures!
It is told that the knight "Silver Moon" once dueled on <color=Highlight>the bridge leading to the Thorncrown Rises near Egla Town</color>, where he bested a hundred challengers.
Honor is a fine blade tempered in the fires of challenge.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Decay of Time.
Decay of Time: The Lifer gains 200% Glacio, Fusion, Electro, Aero, Spectro, and Havoc Resistance. Its Max HP is increased by 25%.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Desire for Escape.
Desire for Escape: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 25%. Additionally, DMG dealt by the Lifer is increased by an additional 25% every 20s.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Growing Loneliness.
Growing Loneliness: The Lifer recovers 10% of its Max HP every second after not being attacked for over 2s.

Deliver 1 Stake of Imbalance to remove the Lifer's Impending Stalemate.
Impending Stalemate: Increases the Lifer's ATK by 20% each time it deals DMG, stacking up to 4 times. If the Lifer deals no DMG within 6s, all stacks will be cleared.

Severely eroded by the Tidal Blight. The damaged area is encrusted with white calcified material.

A lone butterfly… What special meaning might its presence hold here?

The faint abrasions. Could these be the signs of use, or nervous fingers rubbing over time?

You examine the transparent container, which appears to have some kind of liquid inside.

You realize it looks identical to the blood that flowed from Luuk's hand during your fight in the space station.
The picture is a child's drawing of a family, rendered in simple, earnest lines.
A father and an older and younger brother... each one wearing a big, happy smile.
On the back of the framed picture, a scribbled note reads: "Always happy! —Rhein Herssen"
It must have been drawn years ago, but the frame is carefully preserved and shows little wear.
You examine the burnt page. Many parts of it are illegible due to the burns.
It appears to have been salvaged from a fire.
Judging by the legible contents, it's a report.
It mentions Lahai-Roi and Voidmatter, and was originally destined for the New Federation.
At the bottom of the report, you find a signature... the Fractsidus's insignia.
What You Should Never Do As A Startorch Express Passenger (Excerpt)

This team is a mix of students addicted to the redline and the teachers who moonlight as their mechanics and alibis. They all seem to be part of some Fan Club, one that was never officially approved.
According to Mr. S.I.G.M.A., their driving habits are atrocious, and they only get worse on closed roads.
But there is no denying that they are fast. And this time, even right under the nose of Mr. S.I.G.M.A., they can still be fast.

A team made up of the most forgettable faces. After seeing the roster, N.A.N.A. immediately volunteered to join.
They have average builds, average grades, and even their psych evals come back as perfectly "median."
Every student and teacher in this group seems destined to be a background extra in someone else's anime.
But doesn't everyone deserve to be the protagonist of their own story?

By the time Zahira realized she should probably report to her superior, she and her companions had already reached the Academy.
She was no stranger to them. They may be a bit hot-headed, but all proved themselves when they helped chart the terrain.
Now, they prepare to trek across that mountain once more.

Dhalifa has never been much of a talker—hardly surprising, given she only recently found her voice again.
After submitting her application, she stood adrift in the crowd, clutching her notice tight. That's when they approached and invited her in. 
So, let's go together. Maybe saving the world is something only heroes get to do. But us? We'll just do what we can, the best way we know how.

Since when has she been here? 
No one knows. 
How long will she stay? 
Until "here" ceases to exist.

They are the last teams to leave the Research Institute. 
They've probably thought about giving up more than once. And probably, over and over, they've found their courage again.
Anyway, they are still standing here, aren't they?

Normally, no teacher would let their students walk into harm's way, even if that danger is about to sweep across the world.
Unless… those students willingly choose to confront the void head-on.
Then so be it. Let's move out together, till the very end.

We have never feared the threats of Aleph-1.
Only the truth has the power to test our resolve.

In the past, it saved us once. Now, we won't give up on it. 
"Science," "the world," "future"... We aren't fighting for any of those big ideas.
This is our home. We will defend it.

Everyone in Lahai-Roi knows that the Cassettes made by the Spacetrek Collective are just "backups."
They carry our hopes and our resolve to fight the Threnodian to the bitter end. 
But deep down, we all know this portable device won't keep one alive when things go south.
No one wants to be the one who only brings back a teammate's Cassette.
We're all going home together.

A team led by Nastasha. An experienced researcher-in-the-making, she has navigated them through countless dangers.
Of course, the young must eventually weather their own storms...
But there is always someone who volunteers to stand in front of them, even if that someone has only just stepped out of the role of "student" herself.

They are the first teams to leave the Research Institute. 
Don't worry about them. They know exactly what they're walking into.
If all they wanted was a quiet, peaceful life, they never would have set foot in Lahai-Roi to begin with.

In the outlying corner of the Fabricatorium lies an Echo burial ground embedded into deep-sea canyons. Here, heaps of abandoned Brooders cover the floor. Decommissioned Echoes wait in lines to be dismantled and incinerated in the workshops. Their frequencies will be recycled and redirected across the Fabricatorium, feeding the creation of new Echoes.

The core area in the Fabricatorium of the Deep for developing Common Echoes. Endless arrays of Echo Brooders line the space, cradling Echoes awaiting rebirth.
As the foundation of the Common Echo system, this site commands heavy investment of security and research resources by the Order.

The energy storage and distribution center of the Fabricatorium.
The recycled energy from the Fallen Grave converges here, waiting to be distributed to other areas as needed. All energy is reserved in liquid media. Frequencies born of the tides once again dissolve in water.

A praying ground dedicated to the Acolytes dwelling under the sea, the only sanctuary of the Order's undersea expanse that remains untouched by the Fractsidus.
These broken Acolytes are the willing victims of the Order's experiments to free Ragunna's consciousness from the Dark Tide. The countless failed trials shattered their minds, yet still they cling to their fervent memories of faith. Fenrico placed them beneath the waves to live peacefully, away from the prying eyes of the world.

The central tower of the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where the Lost Beyond is created.
As the control hub of the entire Fabricatorium, the tower regulates the activities in all other areas within the facility. Deep in the tower keeps the lantern of the first Primus, the first gift bestowed upon the Order by Sentinel Imperator.

A natural pass of solid bedrock, marked by jagged cliffs and towering stone pillars. As the gateway to the Sanguis Plateaus, it has stood witness for generations as Gladiators embarked on their sacred hunt, all under the silent watch of the stone colossus of Atilius, the Hero of Heroes.

A sprawling encampment near Atilius Canyon. This well-equipped base offers rest and recovery to battle-worn Gladiators. Supported by skilled personnel and Echoes, the camp ensures every Gladiator returns to the hunt at their best, ready to face the Dark Tide creatures once more.

The primary hunting grounds for Septimontians for generations. Legend has it that the forest's eternal crimson hue comes from blood spilled in battle. Gladiators drive the Dark Tide's creations into the woods, using traps, tactics, and brute strength to stem the Dark Tide.

A plateau blooming with Asphodels, where spring winds never quite manage to carry the blossoms out to sea. Here, "spirits" linger where they sought glory while alive, and where death cut their dreams short.
A town wiped out by the Dark Tide. All that remains are the Threnodian Leviathan's whispers and thoughts. People call this place Murmurstown in a desperate attempt to bury an agony too great to bear.

The highest peak in the Sanguis Plateaus, named for both its unique summit and the three Heroes of Heroes who once stood there. To Gladiators, it is sacred ground. Legend says that each Hero of Heroes faced their final trial there, and only then would they conquer fate and be cloaked in glory.
A quiet, deserted quarter, where the city's busiest crossroads once bustled with life. Rows of commercial towers and shops line the street, and at the corner stands the famous Shashou Cafe.

Built under the City Hall's initiative, this once-grand football arena has long fallen into neglect. In its prime, however, the annual "Harukaze Cup" drew school teams from across the region and filled the stands with cheering crowds.

Nestled in the city's center, this park was once a beloved retreat, its gardens draped in cascades of wisteria. The fish windsocks floating above the park used to be a popular sight, but now, for some reason, they all seem to be slowly drifting toward a single spot...
A cultural passage beneath the city, famed for its flower trees and the celebrated Seisen Garden. It was once the city's hub for film festivals and photography exhibitions.

Once Honami's business center, this area is now a graveyard of empty skyscrapers, collapsed passages, and abandoned convention centers. The giant cherry blossom trees rising from the ruins have become its new landmark.

This area was once known as "Honami's most beautiful living quarter," where homes and cherry blossoms stood in perfect harmony. Though the houses now lie hollow and lifeless, the cherry blossoms only flourish more vibrantly…

Named after the colossal Exostrider greatsword that holds up the underground dome, its dark waters feel like a gateway to another world. As one of the few regions shielded from Void Storms, it became the foundation for the Spacetrek Collective's Starward Riseway, a lift that scales the greatsword's spine to link this subterranean oasis with the Roya Frostlands.

A sacred homeland of the Roya and the habitat of the Soliskin. Bathed in the radiance of the Reactor Drive, its towering trees reach hungrily toward the light, their deep, interwoven roots returning that energy to the earth.

A vast waterfall often visited by Jetrays. When they leap in unison, their silver wings form a shimmering curtain, hence the name. They travel in flocks for mutual protection, and Roya herders are often seen being carried by their wings, crossing the skies together in serene harmony.

A grand observational array established by Startorch Academy. Unlike the Cassettes, which record humanity, this system was built to record Lahai-Roi. It continuously tracks terrain shifts, ecological cycles, and celestial disturbances wrought by Void Storms and the Threnodian, like a giant eye observing the turning of the ages.

Officially Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, it stands as a borderless scientific community dedicated to the pure pursuit of knowledge. Its name reflects its ethos, "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Within this vast academic city, knowledge flows freely and cultures meet in harmony.

A terrifying creature born from the Threnodian's influence, found primarily in the hinterland of Lahai-Roi known as the "Mawburrow Desert." Its source of power and its fatal weakness are the Voidmatter Regulators on its head. Wherever it passes, life is extinguished, leaving only the void in its wake.

A lightweight, all-terrain vehicle co-developed by the Department of Exostrider Engineering and the Department of Voidmatters at Startorch Academy. Indispensable for field expeditions, the Academy has created specialized driving courses and multiple training tracks around the campus to cater to the adventurous spirit of its students and faculty.

A colossal lift linking Lahai-Roi to the Roya Frostlands, its structure resembling a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it plummets and ascends through the deep cavern, serving as one of Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.

A warm, humid haven beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift, this region became the new Solaris pole, prompting the Roya to migrate below ground. Here, the Spacetrek Collective established Startorch Academy. Today, this borderless academic city has become a cradle for countless rising scholars.

The music persists, and the crimson curtain rises once more.
In this endless drama, you have no choice but to accompany her, one dance after the other.
An artificial Sonoro built by Phrolova in the Fabricatorium, a manifestation of her life's dreams and aspirations. It is so vast that it defies conventional measurement.

A shifting realm between life and death, existence and nothingness. It is not a place in the physical sense, but a convergence of infinite possibilities that includes all of Iuno's emotions, memories, and connections. 
Here, her specter wanders, stuck reliving her past… until enough fragments of hers are captured and anchored. Only then can the girl erased by the world reclaim her future.

A cutting-edge weapon testing program launched by the Black Shores to minimize field agent losses. 
Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.

Testers are tasked with deploying autonomous combat units within an artificial Sonoro to halt waves of simulated Tacet Discords. The Tethys System evaluates the participants' performance based on how effectively they withhold the assault.

A type of highly difficult test in Tidal Defense Simulator.
In Deathtrap Mode, participants must rely on Overwatch Protocols and enhanced logistical support to withstand evolved waves of Tacet Discords.

An ancient marvel built by master artisans, the Ephor's Palace stands solemnly as a silent witness to the shifts of Septimont through the ages. As the administrative center of Septimont, it upholds the city's order and cohesion. Here, Septimont's leaders convene daily with the Ephor to chart the course of the land's future.
Leviathan's avatar rises with the boundless Dark Tide, seeking to "unify" the world in eternal darkness. Stand against the end, and fight for the faintest hope of dawn.
Amidst the bamboo grove verdant, a killing edge lies hidden.

The Lament's lingering power gathers here, replaying the battles of the past.
Those unfulfilled dreams, unresolved obsessions… They are no myth.

Founded with the core mission to nurture "Synchronists" capable of Augmented Resonance with the Exostrider, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College. Its research is built upon three domains: Exostrider studies, Void Storms, and Reactor Drive energy, giving rise to the Departments of Exostrider Engineering, Voidmatters Science, and Light Energy Sciences. Within the latter, the Division of Ecology Conservation, closely tied to the work of the Exo Genesis Labs, is affectionately nicknamed the "Agronomy Wing."

A live-fire facility for testing tactical weaponry and mechanized constructs, operated by the Division of Tactical Development under the Department of Exostrider Engineering. This site supports full-scale weapon validations and equipment trials, and its grounds are open to all Academy faculty and students.

Bathed in the constant radiance of the Reactor Drive, this plain teems with life. Flora, fauna, and Exoswarm creatures convert light and heat into diverse energy forms, channeling them through intricate ecological cycles. Every being contributes to this self-sustaining web of life.

A vast valley stretching between the Starward Riseway and the Etching Plains. Its name, translated from Royan itself, refers to the jagged square cliffs and stone spires that jut from the valley like the serrated teeth of a giant, forever studded into a scar upon the earth.

An arched region that collapsed many years ago during a subterranean Void Storm eruption. As the land gave way, buried cable grids and mechanical spinal frameworks were laid bare like the sinew and bone of the earth itself.

The Roya elders are organized into the Six—three pairs holding roles such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair is entrusted with a core function: observation, archival, and extrapolation. They dwell within the Solisylum, linking their consciousness to the Heliogyre to trace the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecast Void Storms. To maximize efficiency, only one of the Six remains awake during each cycle to oversee daily affairs. At the close of each season, Shepherds from all settlements gather in Bjartr Woods to deliver their recorded data, which the Six then deliberate upon to chart the future.

Officially Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute, it stands as part of the same borderless research initiative—the Spacetrek Collective—as Startorch Academy. Its mission is to extract and apply advanced technologies. Linked directly to the Starward Riseway, the Institute rests above the greatsword's tip like a guarding Stargram, watching over Lahai-Roi from above.

The sun of Lahai-Roi, the source of its life, the cornerstone of the Royas' sacred duty, and the heart of the Spacetrek Collective's Helios Project. But now, the Exostrider's heart is corrupted by the Threnodian's frequencies, teetering on the brink of collapse. Should it fall, an eternal night will engulf the world.

The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions.
In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

As the hunt begins, horns blare and fearless roars tear through the skies. Beneath the blazing sun, Gladiators gather, blades aflame with valor, swearing to protect Septimont. 
When the Dark Tide surges once more, the foretold hero shall rise to conquer the abyss and defy fate.
By Sun's Scourge, By Moon's Revelation
Everything you've done, the world will forever remember.

When the forsaken city crumbles, neon hues twist and devour the past. Between loops of ruin and rebirth, only the unfulfilled longings linger. In this stagnant season, the warm, simple bonds shall become blades to sever the chains.
Last night's stars still burn. The dawn of tomorrow will arrive.
To the City Set in Amber

Beneath the Startorch, we pledge to carry its flame forward, to stand beside kindred minds, and to push back the frontiers of knowledge. Let every quest for truth be a spark against the long night until it fades. Together, we build a dawn that is ours.

The Priestesses have forgotten. Augusta has forgotten... Even though the world has forgotten, you remember Iuno. After all, you see her once again.
With her bracelet and the moonlight to guide you, you walk on. You don't know where the path leads, only that you must keep going, until the moonlight finally falls.
Humble and unadorned, this place offers a transitory respite in the looping Lament.
Here, infinite loops pile atop each other, and people's cries become sustenance for the Lament. In the ruins of chaos, only the Tower shows its true face...

Inside Neon Tower, she fell into the cage of her own making.
Perhaps the girl never truly left her hometown, just as she never escaped her past…
Never in memory has Honami been this quiet…. Chisa, where are you?

The unfamiliar city teeters on the verge of collapse.
From the depths of your memory comes a faint, painful whisper... This is the Lament.

A ruined city, like amber trapped in the Sonoro. Once-bustling streets lie overgrown with wild grass, low roads swallowed by seawater. The Lament repeats endlessly, and time and space are fractured, but this view seems frozen, stopped in a silent eternity.

This soaring communication tower once embodied people's ambition to connect through radio waves. But eventually, it was here that the Lament began. Now, within its disordered heart, it recreates glimpses of familiar pasts, as if luring others to step deeper inside…

The past, the reality, the Lament... Such is the view from atop Neon Tower. See them. Face them. Confront them.
Step into tomorrow. Nothing can stand in your way.

When Voidmatter density reaches a critical threshold, the Shimmer descends from the skies and the earth quakes beneath it—the Void Storm follows, Lahai-Roi's most devastating catastrophe. All matter dissolves into nothingness, while infected Exoswarm mutate into massive Voidworms, casting devouring shadows across the land.

When a Resonator's mental strength and Forte are pushed beyond their limits for an extended period, it can lead to a rare state called "Overclocking." While this condition can be managed, there's no permanent cure. In extreme cases, the Tacet Mark can expand uncontrollably, devouring everything around it, with the Overclocked Resonators ultimately becoming a Tacet Discord of the Tacet Field.

Formed from Tacetite and hidden in the Stormy Sea, this archipelago is a sanctuary for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, it has fostered extensive partnerships across Solaris-3. While its advanced technologies are shared with the outside world, their origins remain a mystery, even to its members.

Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.
At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator".

Memories converge into frequencies at the fingertip, where sound and form unite—the authority you were born with. Formless echoes coalesce through your power, as you continuously weave a deeper resonance with the world.

The Sentinel of Rinascita, the one who guided the settlers to this promised land to escape from the Lament. In the faith of the Order of the Deep, They are often depicted as a being with the upper body of a horse and the lower body of a fish. Though Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the world, They often deliver Oracles through the Laureate of Carnevale.

A Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It gathers in the sky above and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field. According to the Order of the Deep, the two significant Dark Tides that occurred in history were stopped by Napoli the Second and the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys respectively.

Thanks to the Genesis Nexus, Rinascita's Echoes can exist without Reserved Terminals. The people of Ragunna revere Common Echoes as divine gifts from Sentinel Imperator and treat them as friends and trusted allies. Managed by the Order of the Deep, Common Echoes are incorporated into every aspect of daily life, which is the very symbol that has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."

Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty. Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.
The sighs of that person still linger here. O you who are bound in chains, to whom could you ever confide such endless sorrow?

Due to the special nature of this celebration and the Roya Culture Exhibition joining this year's festivities, the Student Council secured the first two floors of Rabelle College with the help of certain talented coordinators. Once tightly restricted classrooms have been transformed into vibrant club showcase spaces.

Every year, the break after final exams marks the season for Startorch Academy's club exhibitions—the perfect outlet for students to burn off their pent-up energy.
With the Reactor Core restored and the New Solar Ceremony a success, the Academy's Executive Committee has announced that this year's showcase will be co-hosted with the Roya. Under the theme "New Solar Celebration," the event aims to deepen the bonds between both peoples.
Time to blast off on an interstellar adventure!
Use this time to totally let loose!
Catch the cosmic beat and set sail!

When the Spacetrek Collective dared to build a facility atop a Threnodian, they had planned for the worst.
When Voidmatter broke loose, some left bearing hope. Others stayed, resolve burning in their chests.

A future that was never hers. One she would never reach.
A dream as fragile as a bubble, bound to pop. Still, isn't there always a sweetness in wanting what you cannot hold?

Beneath the shadowed trench, an empty yet defiant gaze hungrily covets the legacy of the heavens.
Once a sacred land, only a faint shadow of Avinoleum's glory remains. Those destined to fall still live, while those meant to survive lie buried, transformed into divine oracles no one hears. Their lips remain sealed, and Their ears are bound by words They never spoke.

The capital city of Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states. Perched atop Capitoline Hill, it boasts towering stone structures that form the grand "Gryphon's Fortress." After fleeing the threat of the Dark Tide, the bold and battle-loving Septimontians have devoted their lives to chasing the heights of glory. With travelers from distant seas, they gather in this City of Glory built upon the legends of heroes.

The heart of the Great Agon, where Gladiators and Echoes fight side by side. With state-of-the-art facilities, the arena hosts electrifying tournaments of all sizes, broadcast live across Solaris. Here, the air is thick with the crowd's roaring cheers, shattering the silence of the night year-round. It's a place where your blood ignites as you witness the blood, sweat, and tears of Gladiators battling for glory.

An area at the base of Capitoline Hill, near the Borderline Fort. Herds graze in peace throughout lush pastures, and scattered villages nestle among ancient ruins. Yet even in such tranquility, small arenas remain a vital part of life.

A vast plain framed by mountain ranges. Named for the giant boulder clusters left by ancient lava flows, it was here that Septimontian civilization first took root centuries ago. Now, only scattered old villages remain, where wayfaring outlanders often rest before crossing into the Septimont highlands.

A precipitous mountain range that marks the border of Septimont. The craggy peaks form a natural barrier between Septimont and the outside world. During the first outbreak of the Dark Tide, the Border Mountains bore the brunt, leaving them forever scarred by ashen traces and Tidal Blight calcification.

The remains of a coast eroded by the Dark Tide. Temples and sacred statues once erected by Ragunnesi Acolytes now lie in ruin. Their silent halls, devoid of worshippers, are spread across the canyon floor, transformed into haunted dwellings of Tacet Discords.

A dragon of yore once perished in the Border Mountains, attracting numerous dissonant frequencies. Over the years, the area became plagued by Tacet Discords and ferocious creatures. Founding Septimontians saw it as a testing ground for warriors to prove their mettle, leaving behind countless tales of glory. This continued until the first Dark Tide swept through, laying waste to this sanctum of trials and burying its honor beneath Tidal Blight.

Officially known as "Remnant Cubes," these advanced artificial intelligences were created for the Second Coming of Solaris using Encore's abilities and Tethys's microprocessing support.
The Remnant Cubes differ from their originals in subtle to outright obvious ways. The cause of these variations remains unclear. Is it the user acting as the anchor point, Tethys's scanning and data support, or Encore's artistic leeway as the master artisan?

Ciaccona's Sonoro Sphere, created through her perception of melodies and echoes.
Memories and stories carried by the melodies manifest here as still, frozen images.
But through Ciaccona's tuning, these stories and memories come together as notes on a music sheet.
As the notes play, the images begin to move and unfold.
What will become of this twisted tale? What awaits at the end of this path, beyond the heroes' triumph...?

In broad daylight, Daemons once devoured in a great fire whisper through the streets of Ragunna. They wield beloved poetry and music as weapons of their curse. A confrontation, wrapped in the language of art, begins to unfold on the stage of Rinascita.
Remnants of past sins resurge. From deep beneath the earth, they scheme and plot. When the flames that once ripped through the night return, a silent war will begin.

The brighter the glory, the deeper the shadow. Amid the arena's deafening roar, tales of joy distort and drown in the icy embrace of the deep.
A champion's path is fraught with peril. When glory itself is burnt to ash by its own flames, none can say who will reach the end victorious.

Sol-III, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.

The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."

The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.

The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.

Individuals with the ability to resonate with certain objects and manipulate their frequencies are known as "Resonators." These individuals exhibit unique "Resonance Abilities," also known as their "Fortes," through the "Tacet Mark" on their bodies. According to experts, a Resonator's abilities are often influenced by their past experiences and subconscious mind.

Tacet Discords, created by the Waveworn Phenomena, are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms. They possess "Tacet Cores" and feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.

A type of special frequency that can be captured by the Terminal to reproduce Tacet Discords' abilities.
Tacet Discords may leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.

Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and guides. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As we embark on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain our record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.

Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.

Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.

The Waveworn Phenomena is believed to alter matter, information, and energy by converting them into vibrating "frequencies" referred to as "Reverberations." This process has been observed through experimental evidence in the academic community.

A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.
In their studies of Waveworn Phenomena, scientists discovered "Tacetite"—a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. The Tacetite can be made into potent weapons for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords. Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.

The Black Shores, an archipelago enshrouded in mysteries and turmoil, remains sealed away from the world in thick digital fog. It remains uncertain when or who will lift its veil, allowing it to once more shoulder the task of connecting the world.

As an untuned melody drifts across the night sky, the torchlights that once illuminated the stars now instead devour them in crimson blaze. Listen to the true cries concealed within the Lament, and face them with unwavering courage. Hope will be born anew.

The upper and lower realms of the Black Shores are distinct yet interconnected, much like day and night. Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...

The garden, nestled within the depths of the subterranean galaxy, serves as both the lens to observe its great expanse and the Shorekeeper's dwelling during her confinement by the Tethys System. It is said that the garden existed well before the founding of the Black Shores, functioning as the eye that gazes upon the stars. However, what the eye perceives may remain unknown to the heart. What truths lie behind these supreme concepts?

An ancient, secluded town nestles within the tranquil embrace of Mt. Firmament. Elegant structures, scattered among the crimson leaves and tipped with pure white snow, create a scene of serene beauty. 
For centuries, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, as their god, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. Despite the year-round snowfall blanketing Mt. Firmament, the warm springs flowing from the mountains and the vibrant life of the townsfolk make the cold no more a concern.

A sanctuary in the southeastern seas of Jinzhou, sealed away beyond the reach of common folks in thick fogs.
According to ancient records, Mt. Firmament is the ancestral home of Jinzhou's earliest settlers. Sentinel Jué once descended upon this land, using the power of Temporal Mandate to protect it from Tacet Discords. Consequently, the flow of time within Mt. Firmament diverges from that of the outside world. 
In earlier times, scholars from the Court of Savantae were fortunate enough to uncover the mountain's hidden mysteries, leaving behind research facilities and invaluable records before vanishing without a trace.

The capsule that descended with the Sentinel upon Mt. Firmament now lies concealed in the depths of Loong's Rest, known to the people of Hongzhen as the Mianloong Chamber. 
The townsfolk believe that Sentinel Jué may hail from a distant star, and that the Mianloong Chamber served as its hibernation capsule. This site marks the end of the pilgrimage and the gateway to Jinzhou's true future.

A future beyond this System lies beyond sight.
Its fall shall usher forth the world's inevitable ruin.
Frozen, torn asunder, consumed by flame... So be it, gaze now upon the world's end.

The land is engulfed in flames, while the Necrostar swallows the sky. The black hole at the pinnacle of the Port City of Guixu marks the beginning and the end of destruction. It also holds the key to salvation... Or perhaps, merely a lie.

On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future.
The tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end.
Yet, the guardian of this final destination, like yourself, is but a remnant of that very future.

A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 
The Rinascitan people, with their unique "Common Echoes," have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."

Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. Magnificent sculptures and paintings grace the city at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life.

The Order of the Deep worships Sentinel Imperator and holds de facto rule over Ragunna. According to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word. Under the leadership of the current Primus, Fenrico, a series of laws were enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.

At the farthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven lies an island where a labyrinth of woods and ruins surrounds a central lake. It is spoken of in knight's tales, said to be the destination of their quests. To this day, the restless spirits of those who sought it wander the ancient paths of the grove.

The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum.

Built by the Montelli family, Averardo Vault stands like a heavily guarded fortress on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures, including precious metals, artworks, and rare Echoes. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.

This peninsula thick with oak trees was once where Rinascita's rulers gathered for secret councils. The Oracles carved into the stone and trees have withstood the passage of time, though their messages are now nearly impossible to distinguish.

The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread.

The Fool's Troupe travels across all of Rinascita, but their base sits in a vast cavern on Penitent's End. Their creed is freedom, their treasure is laughter, and their gift to every city they visit is a new tale.

This forsaken island, shrouded in dense sea mist, is dominated by steep cliffs with giant ringed structures. Ships caught in the currents often end up stranded on the island's treacherous shores. For those lucky enough to survive the wreck, even greater horrors await...

Averardo Bank utilizes an Echo train system to move clients' collections and staff to and from Averardo Vault.
Once the Echo trains reach the underground station of Averardo Vault, the collections within will undergo a second sorting process before being moved to specialized storage facilities.
A facility holding collections of works of art and rare Echoes from across the world, even including artifacts that have survived the Lament and Echoes from ancient times.

Collections housed in this area are often referred to as "vessels of creativity and ingenuity."
For artists and inventors laboring under the patronage of a wealthy family, all their creations, tangible or intangible, are considered assets of the patrons.
The act of creation becomes a measure of worth, by which these creators' value is defined.
Located within the depths of Averardo Vault, off Echo train network, this tower is known to few. What dark secrets does the place hide?

A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...
Once a theological seminary of Rinascita, it now rests in the boundless expanse of clouds. It once recorded Rinascita's glory and grandeur, along with countless unspeakable secrets.
A seminary faintly visible through a thin veil of clouds. Suspended upside down in the sky, it stands solemn and silent, as though carrying the weight of the Blessed Maiden's life.

"The mortal world is a vast and mysterious ocean, wherein all souls are doomed to drown and sink to the depths. Those who refuse to be swallowed must learn to rise, climbing upward until their heads break the surface. Only then shall they glimpse the realm of the divine."
This proverb, written by the Order, is preserved within the tower.

Majestic and serene, ancient yet still sacred. This is the coronation platform prepared for the Blessed Maiden, though an aura of control lingers above. When the heavy weight of "divine right" falls upon one's head, it feels as if all choices have already been made.

Once the dwelling of dragons, this place witnessed those ancient, mighty beings soaring through the sky.
Now, wild vines and flowers steadily consume the garden's former glory while the buried history of dragons slumbers in cursed lairs.

An ancient, mysterious castle perched on the edge of a cliff in the outskirts.
Surrounded by lush flora reminiscent of deep-sea creatures, its interior houses similarly strange and wondrous treasures. Enticing yet bizarre, it pulls the curious in like a whirlpool, drawing them to step inside.

The music persists, and the crimson curtains are set to rise once more.
Will you share another dance with her in this long, unfolding drama?
It is said that the fates of the Fisalia heirs are bound to three towering spires, and this is one of them.

The Sonoro Sphere of Phrolova.
Amid the wild revelry, she beckons you to join in the dance, offering a story in exchange and unveiling the truth behind the curtain.

The vault, controlled by the Montelli family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.

A hall set for a banquet, grand enough to dazzle, yet secret enough to conceal.
At this very moment, a trade initiated by one Montelli is being undone by another.
Behind the mirror lies a realm where the illusions of the past intertwine with reality, yet the path ahead leads to an completely different destiny.
Realm of Ego: Mirrors in the Mirror
A prison built of power and fear is strong enough to chain the mind—but it cannot silence the song that rises from within people's hearts.

The deepest point of the Averardo Vault. Lower ranking staff might not even be aware of its existence. Legend say an intruder would meet their end at the hands of the Echo guard, descending from a height to deliver their fate.

A desolate field of ruins that sits near the Strand. As fog cloaks the sea, distant whispers emanate from within, enchanting the weary sailors. Little do they notice, they're lured into a howling vortex and a realm of death.

Time and space collapse into chaos here, and all things dissolve into nothingness. When the storm heralds a new world, the crown of thorns will finally settle upon her head.
Thereafter, Divinity descends.

Ancient, enigmatic spirits slumber in the lake's depths. Their eyes once summoned stars, leaving trails of fleeting, radiant light across the night sky. As you glide across the lake, another vast world seems to stir in its reflection, just within reach.

An annual festival in Egla Town to honor those who have passed.
When night falls, the townspeople don masks and dress as ghosts to attend the commemorative event. Legend has it that on the Night of Remembrance, vengeful spirits return to the mortal realm. Who's to say whether the person reveling beside you is human, or something else...
A mysterious gateway has appeared, leading to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris...
Resonators ignore 25% of the enemy's DEF when dealing damage. When enemies are affected by Negative Statuses, their DMG taken is Amplified by 20%.
When a Resonator casts Intro Skill, they gain a Shield of 3000 HP. When a Resonator gains a Shield, their Crit. DMG increases by 10% for 30s, stacking up to 5 times.

Total DMG is increased by 10%. When the Resonator casts a Tune Break skill, the total DMG of all Resonators in the team increases by 10%. This effect can be triggered once every 15s and can stack up to 3 times. When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Rupture DMG, the total DMG of all Resonators in the team increases by 40% for 30s.
Enemy's All-Attribute RES is increased by 15%. When the enemy takes Tune Rupture DMG or Fusion Burst DMG, this effect is removed.

Total DMG is increased by 10%, and enemies take 100% more total Fusion Burst DMG and 100% more Tune Rupture DMG. 
When a Resonator casts Tune Break, their total DMG dealt increases by 10%. This effect can be triggered once every 15s and can stack up to 3 times.

One of the near-orbit space stations humanity built before the Etheric Sea sealed off Solaris. Magnetic disturbances from the Lament sent it crashing down, but it remained largely whole. Its ruins once sheltered the Roya from the cold and served as an exploration outpost.
This sector houses SkyArk's most significant pre-Lament research achievement—a prototype Mass Relay Device powered by Etheric Sea Droplets.

Located within the research base zone, the Icebreak Port is the only regular access point into the Roya Frostlands. Upon arrival, personnel and supplies may be transferred via the Starward Riseway to the underground haven of Lahai-Roi, or routed deeper into the frostlands through the inter-outpost roads.

Once a forest-thick fjordland in the frigid zone, this region was home to the nomadic Roya. Then came Lahai-Roi's first recorded Lament that triggered a geomagnetic pole shift. The land was transformed into the new polar extremity of Solaris, buried beneath endless snow and ice. The violent shift also dragged near-orbit satellites and space stations from the sky. Their wreckage still litters the frostlands to this day.

Formally known as the Spacetrek Collective: Frostlands Polar Research Outpost, this facility is a joint project between the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya people. Built around the Exostrider's greatsword embedded in the ice, it serves as a vital logistics hub.
Here, researchers work to salvage pre-Lament data from fallen satellites and space stations, run non-invasive diagnostics on the Exostrider to monitor its restoration, and survey the ecosystem to revive the long-frozen flora and fauna of the ancient world.

During the second Lament recorded in Lahai-Roi, the Exostrider, a colossal mech from an unknown civilization, emerged through the Stridergate. It fought a fierce battle against the Threnodian to seal the catastrophe from the other side, a clash that shattered the very bedrock of the frostlands.
As the Roya faced annihilation, the Exostrider channeled its remaining power and drove the greatsword deep into the earth to brace the collapsing land. Its Reactor Drive transformed into a subterranean sun, casting warmth into the depths. Its scattered fragments reassembled into the Exoswarm that mimic the local lifeforms, guiding the Roya toward a new homeland. Since then, the Exostrider fell dormant upon the surface, awaiting the day of its awakening.

Vast, boundless space erodes all sense of time, where endlessly repeating moments hold equal weight. The long voyage has yet to reach its end, and the coordinates of the starting point have long since worn away. Infinite possibilities collapse into a single next instant—still a miracle by any name, with no need to return.

The public auditorium in Startorch Academy that serves as the primary venue for large-scale indoor events. It is available for student activities. To host an event here, student societies or fan clubs must submit a proposal and application to the Student Council at least three working days in advance. Upon approval, the event will be officially registered and circulated.
There lies a forever festival that one day shall end.
For You Who Walk in Snow
Fine snow drifts gently to the ground, carrying with it the entwined fates of those who walk upon the snow.
Here, fading voices and hidden trails are woven into a web, and the rationale of liquid gold is patiently unraveled…

Named after Scott Rabelle, the founder of Resonance Curve Theory and inventor of the Rabelle's Curve, this college—also known as the Synchronist Department—identifies and trains Synchronists through uncompromisingly rigorous, data-driven methods. 
Access to Rabelle College requires special authorization and is ordinarily closed to students from other departments.

A collective Sonoro that manifested naturally in Lahai-Roi. The exact cause of its formation remains unconfirmed.
Influenced by the subconscious minds and residual frequencies of the Resonators at Startorch Academy, it gradually evolved into a mirrored projection of the Academy, becoming a unique phenomenon existing within its grounds.

Ambition, passion, anxiety, sorrow… the Academy's Dark Side absorbs them all without distinction, reflecting the students' rawest and most unguarded thoughts.
If left unchanneled, these accumulated negative emotions gather within the domain, eventually spilling into reality.

The Research Institute sealed the Dark Side within riddles, rendering it harmless and turning it into an annual game students eagerly await.
By solving these riddles, students confront their doubts directly, releasing and dispelling the negative energy accumulated in the Dark Side.

If the Dark Side is a vortex, then anxiety and sorrow form its very eye.
Interfered with by the Fractsidus, these negative emotions are now manifesting as aggressive Tacet Discords.

Every student who enters Startorch Academy does so with a sincere heart.
Such hearts are treasures that must never be allowed to be tainted.

The rabbit guides those who venture into the Academy's Dark Side, leading them to confront the fears and truths they usually avoid.
Even after Sigrika's incident, some students and professors continue to face their own dilemmas within the Dark Side.

People's expectations are like gold, both a blessing and a heavy weight. Even amid the New Solar Celebration's laughter, doubt and emptiness can take root.
When truth stands on the scales, the lurking shadows ask their final, piercing question: Does the pursuit of discovery truly have meaning?

The true destination of the Soliskin after they return to the Solistrees. They become warm sunlight, flowing down the roots and converging as sparks within the Solvein Heartwood to keep the encroaching Voidmatter at bay.

The first Helios prototype was swallowed by a Voidstorm, ending up here where it drew the Soliskin's attention.
Twilight marks the hour after sunset. In the Dimmr Plains, this is the Soliskin's final gathering place before they return to the Solistrees.

To stop a past Voidmatter breach, Hiyuki drew upon her Futures' Tithe and channeled a portion of her power to create a seal over the rift.
The miko gave everything she had. She always did.
A precipice in the depths of Lahai-Roi touched by Voidmatter. Here, sound itself is consumed.
Ancient plants, awakened after countless ages, grow in forms not of this time. Beneath shifting auroras, a dreamlike veil falls over secrets too old to tell.

Here, Voidmatter's power swells to its peak. Beyond this point lies the Stridergate, a passage to a universe now beyond your reach.
Beyond the Stridergate lies the sea of stars you long for, and the darkness that fills you with dread.
For reasons unknown, the dreams of the Left Behind in Honami have manifested in a corner of Lahai-Roi. Anchored to a Somnoire gate, fantasy and reality overlap here in chaotic disorder.

—Scrawled across a message board in uneven strokes—
"Do not forget the regret that brought you here."
Here, past and present converge, and time and space unravel into chaos.

It devours everything. Thought, feeling, hope, all reduced to dust and nothingness.
It is the Void.

An anchor set over the Stridergate long ago with the Exostrider's arrival. It is essential to opening the gateway.
One day, it will be flung open, even if it was meant to keep the danger out.

To prove they can endure the extreme neural load of connecting to the Exostrider, Synchronists must pass a synchronization test.
All for the torch of humanity.

Denia. She is denied both a past and future.
Aleph-1 looks upon her. And upon you. What lies before you is absurdity, nihilism, collapse... A puzzle with no solution.
But still, she waits for your answer.
Reverbs From the End of Galaxies

You know all too well that this world has no all-knowing, all-powerful savior.
The steps of countless others have become the path beneath your feet. So take one more step forward. What echoes behind you are the voices from beyond the sea of stars itself.

Unique Tacet Discord. A Gulpuff born from anomalous data, this creature possesses an enormous size and terrifying destructive power. 

While Gulpuffs are usually Common Class Tacet Discords, this one has acquired exceptional combat ability and a violent temper due to the influence of anomalous data. Maintaining a safe distance is advised.

Unique Tacet Discord. A Fusion Warrior born from anomalous data, possessing combat skills beyond imagination.

Its dual-wielded blades, replacing its arms, appear almost sentient, exploiting every weakness in an opponent's stance.

The specific frequency it mimicked to achieve such mastery in swordsmanship remains a mystery.

Unique cluster of Tacet Discords. A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

While individual Cruisewings are weak, their combined forces can create a powerful storm.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.

Unique group of Tacet Discords. Two Tambourinists fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss—so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.

Unique Tacet Discord. A Rocksteady Guardian formed from anomalous data, capable of smashing through multiple rock layers with a single blow. 

Despite its slow movement, its devastating force is more than enough to make up for it.

Once a sacred place, this island is now a grave of sorrow, and any who come for redemption must face its fire of judgment.

Such is Gehinom, the Dragon of Dirge, whose flames burn to the bone, whose pain echoes, yearning for a final release.

This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

Once a creature born of Nimbus Sanctum, Lorelei gained intelligence through the Sentinel Imperator's power, entrusted to purify corrupted frequencies drifting in the clouds.

Yet wicked desires have transformed her into the “Queen of Night,” seeking to cloak the Nimbus in endless darkness to clear all sins.

With her final grasp on reason, Lorelei sealed herself within her garden, where she sings a haunting lament, awaiting one who can awaken her from this dismal slumber.

This enemy has <color=HighlightB>increased RES</color> to <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>

Refitted with special technology, this Echo has transformed into a precise and powerful battle machine, carrying out its master's commands with absolute loyalty.

Any trace of its original form has faded, leaving only finely honed combat instincts within its frequencies. An unyielding guardian, it adapts seamlessly to all types of combat, and when needed, unlocks a unique component to enhance mobility or unleashes all its energy in a devastating blast.

The Montelli Family, voyaging from distant shores, has seen a wider world—and they are willing to pay any price to gain the strength needed to revive their homeland.

This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

She guards the City of Glory, a valiant lioness of the arena.

Her body, hewn from the same white marble that formed the Gryphons. Her spirit, forged from the echoes of battle cries and the laughter of heroes.

This is Arsinosa, ever steadfast, watching over Septimont's glory for all time.

This enemy has <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
A despair devotee, a fallen soul devoured by an illusory paradise.
When the mask of Dark Tide was dropped, he found clarity at the end of his path—hope and redemption traded with a perished form.
He will forever sleep at the bottom of the dark sea, for there too lies the way home.

This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

A humanoid molded of sludge. The False Sovereign, the Dark Tide's will made manifest.

Born from the utopia of Unity envisioned by the Threnodian, it is a shapeless mass of black sludge given form, a vessel created solely to devour. All things are to unite within the False Sovereign's body and be reborn as servants and children of Leviathan.

It does not think. It does not feel. Only the rippling sludge murmurs its false hymns, eternally glorifying the power of Leviathan.

This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

A fallen one adrift in the frigid currents, a ruptured remnant in which Threnodian's residual energy resides.

She pierced her own heart and fell into the ocean. But fate, relentless as the whirlpools below, dragged her even deeper.

Now, her creator has claimed this failed vessel, lying in wait beneath the waves to devour the entire world.

This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

Its core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.

This enemy has a <color=HighlightB>higher RES</color> to <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activity of Aleph-1. When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Till its body collapses, till the last speck of starlight goes dark.

Among the prized treasures of the Montelli family is a morph painting depicting Hadrian, the legendary gladiator, with his blade drawn. In Ragunna, these paintings have the special power to pull anyone who touches them into the sphere within, allowing them to experience it as though it were real.
At the heart of Trattoria Margherita is an oven Echo known as Bakie, tirelessly fueling Ragunna with its roaring flames and delicious aromas.

To be a true performer, one must first learn how to listen. Give your records, sheet music, or any musical medium to the Aria Mummer. Don't be alarmed when it swallows and chews these items—it's simply its way of "listening" to the music.

Passersby are often drawn to the delicate hands reaching out from the Averardo Bank. These hands are perfectly adorned, always gesturing with elegance and grace...
Though their owner is just an Echo teller.

Once a lonely Echo drifting through the seas, Lario has spent years without a companion until it joined the Troupe of Fools. All people know about it is its genus—Pliosaurus Somnii. Though the troupe has sailed across many waters near Rinascita, they have yet to encounter another like it.

C-MOSS, the camera Echo owned by the Pioneer Association's Ragunna branch, acts with all the fine manners of an old gentleman. He captures moments in time with care, often sipping a cup of developer solution between shots.

Before they fall into slumber, the Farceur's Faces of the Masked Reverie fill Ragunna's days and nights with their playful banter. As the shop's iconic mascots, they've garnered their fair share of noise complaints.
An Echo boat that quietly glides through Ragunna's canals, offering a safe and silent voyage to all who hop on it, often known as the Water Bus.

Once, when the Dark Tide ravaged the city and Tacet Fields spread like a plague, Signor Octopus's duty was to sound the alarms. Those days are like a distant dream now, yet he still announces the hour with a gentle horn, guarding the city's peace with quiet dedication.
An Echo lantern that belongs to the Order of the Deep, serving as the Order's watchful eyes to monitor the people of Ragunna.
Originally transformed from discarded dolls, these plushie Echoes have evolved to feel delicate human emotions. For them, these emotions are delicious frequencies to be savored with relish.

Spotted throughout Ragunna's streets, the Tubpups are lively Echoes that serve as faithful companions. Whether they are playing with children, carrying art supplies, or working as handy baskets, they bring joy and energy wherever they go.

Mist rises over the sea, carrying echoes from all directions—songs, the creak of windmills, and the bustling noise of city streets. For sailors weary from the monotony of life at sea, these sounds become an irresistible siren call. Entranced, they steer their ships toward the heart of the mist, unaware they are sailing straight into the Tacet Discord's trap…
But as in every tale where despair festers, a glimmer of hope is bound to emerge. Even in these treacherous waters, someone will break the storm and waves and bring light to all.

A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song.

Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix.

The abnormal Voidworm activity has been contained, and the Academy's crisis has passed. While the Voidworm has returned to its normal route, lingering Voidmatter disturbances have yet to fully dissipate. Continued monitoring is required.
Use the Route Constructor to generate a skill-based race track. Pass through all Score Rings to complete the challenge and claim your reward.

Minna has just bought her very first Terminal, but she doesn't seem to have the faintest idea how to use it...
Find her in Bjartr Woods and lend a hand before she accidentally breaks it.
You've caught the attention of a particularly perceptive Terminal assistant. He claims there exists a race track where no one has ever crossed the finish line...

A melody, once scattered to the winds, is now sought by Soliskin who yearn to hear it whole again. 
Follow them to a place heavy with memory. Work with the Soliskin to restore the lost "music sheet." If the music returns, the story it holds may finally awaken.
Mechascout: Transition is equipped with a customized giant mech arm, powerful enough to send anyone flying a remarkable distance with a single throw.

Certain areas in Lahai-Roi are rich with Supply Chests.
Use your Sensor and the Owlwatch Scanner on your expedition motorbike to locate them.
In Solaris's data space, invisible offenses and defenses occur every day. Before the malice inside the matrix annihilates everything, find it... and put an end to it.

Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander Lahai-Roi.
Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Soliseed Plains. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.

The nexus of an ecological information network designed based on the principles of Wutherium Science. Typically situated in medium and large towns, it detects and models energy fluctuations, activities of Tacet Discords, and other abnormal signals to provide early warnings of Waveworn Phenomena.

In the Roya Frostlands and Lahai-Roi, the Resonance Nexus is known as the Solis Lens Array. These lenses concentrate and convert the glow of the Reactor Drive into usable power for local facilities.

Rage and tears. Suffering and joy. Sorrow and pain. All are condensed, along with her sigh, into a single golden frequency.
It gazes at the sky, lost in memories worn thin by the ages. The lost voyager is still searching for the way home.

A being who exists only because of Aleph-1. Even that gentle smile of hers has been taken away.
Her name, her identity, her Forte, even her bonds with others… all of it a lie.
Yet, the world will not sink into boundless darkness. The end of the path she walks must not be eternal emptiness.

Void Storms across the frostlands are corrupting the Soliskin…
Guide the Soliskin to the corrupted Giant Soliskin and help cleanse them.

A series of small printing machines installed by the Academy. When a Void Storm causes severe disruption, they deploy Cube Blockers to protect their core components.
After the Void Storm passes, any heavily affected machines require manual reset. Operators must disable the Cube Blockers to restore normal operation.

Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Frostlands Surface.
Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in the Upphaf Life Chamber.

The station fell like a dying star, burying the dream of its era beneath ice and soil.
The Explorer was one of those who dreamed, who once walked among the stars.
But now he hides in the dark, corrupted by the Void.
Before reason and strength slipped entirely from his grasp, he sealed himself away in the cabin.
A Soliskin and Its Mysterious Friend
Your usual meeting place with Platya. With the Black Shores–Spacetrek Collective exchange program underway, she passes through here every time she comes to the Academy.
After hearing that the "Lady Miko" might have ties to the Special Response Force, she asks you to consult I.R.I.S. while she continues to gather intel around campus.
Rumor has it, a few expedition researchers owe their lives to a mysterious "Lady Miko." Platya passes you the coordinates of one camp, and you head there to see what clues might be waiting.
You catch wind of a “Film-Loving Ghost Miko” urban legend in the Academy's group chat. You decide to head to the screening room to check it out.
A Soliskin has made a mysterious new friend. Platya suspects it might be the "Lady Miko" herself, and since the Soliskin trusts you, she asks you to follow it and find out if her hunch is right...

It seems the "Lady Miko" is intentionally keeping her distance, and Platya starts to notice. But even if they never meet, she still wants to give her a gift. You suggest asking others from Honami for insight. Chisa comes to mind...
With Platya's gift finally finished, you think of the one person in contact with the "Lady Miko," Lucilla. You decide to ask her to deliver it on Platya's behalf.
This area generates a fixed number of Tacet Discords daily, which may drop the corresponding Echo set after being defeated.
A cavern in Starblind Crashsite, standing solemnly in the biting wind and snow of the frostlands.
A long, narrow cave inside the Exostrider Observation Station, marked by complex geological formations.
Even upon the pale land, warm hues still flow. This path leads onward to Ginnungamere.
Turbulent Voidmatter lies sealed behind the door, entombing with it the dreams of those who fell.
The Song of Ice and Steel
Though buried deep beneath the snow, the rusted iron bird still longs to sing.
Hope is not found in spring, but in deep winter, when life first begins to sprout.
An underground cavern beneath the Twilight Woodlands. Over the years, the leaking energy of the sunken Helios prototype has crystallized, forming a giant crystal there.
The battlefield where the Exostrider once confronted Aleph-1. It is now a graveyard of buried Exostrider components. Weathered by time, it has come to be known as Rustbound Hillside.
A secret research facility hidden deep within the Silent Crag. It is concealed by unique terrain and a high density of Voidmatter.
A rift torn open by Hiyuki's slash. A gateway that beckons you back into the crushing depths of the void.
Startorch Academy's old dormitory swallowed whole by Void Storms. The structures remain, forever lifeless.

The Voidbane Eldertree in the Sealed Fissure is protected by Hiyuki's Resonance Ability. Though not severely contaminated by Voidmatter, the tree is frozen under thick ice.
The Voidbane Eldertree in the Dimmr Deep sits right at the site of the decisive battle. As a result, the tree's root system is buried under rubble.
The Voidbane Eldertree in Solisia Landing is severely contaminated by Voidmatter. Fortunately, Exostrider components scattered across the area can be used to help restore it.

A scientific research outpost jointly built by Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe. This base camp provides full logistical and operational support for field expeditions. With facilities for observation, sampling, experimentation, communication, energy storage, and life support, it stands as a haven to help researchers work safely and steadily during the long-term operations in the Dimmr Plains.
Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy
The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, along with a bizarre, tangled dreamscape. Somehow, you even see Namipon in the midst of this chaos...

Seek out the lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to Solisia Landing. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.

Though the Threnodian is gone, its shadow lingers. Help the Spacetrek Collective eliminate the relentless threats across the Dimmr Plains. It seems that ice blades found across the plains can be utilized as powerful tools...
A Light Builder is a light-sensitive data storage component of the Exostrider that can be powered by Soliskin energy. Adjust its projection to the correct shape to activate the device.
Upon an ancient yet vibrant isle of ruins, follow the feathers that shimmer like auroras. Witness the reawakening of a story that has slumbered for ages...
A challenge where you must dodge falling blocks. Inspired by a timeless classic, you need to fill an entire row to clear it. Hold your ground long enough, and victory is yours.
A motorbike challenge track themed around gliding. Collect enough points to clear the challenge.

Advance on a designated track, get past any obstacles in your way, and earn enough points to complete the challenge.
Use Drift to slide under barriers or Bounce Jump to leap over obstacles. You may also use Drift to swing out the motorbike through certain spots to grab more points.
A motorbike challenge track themed around stunt performance. Collect enough points to clear the challenge.

In the Twilight Woodlands of the Dimmr Plains, the Helios prototype—once lost to a Void Storm—now lies here in a silent slumber. It accompanied generations of Soliskin through their journeys and bore witness to the pure intentions of the first researchers.
Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Dimmr Plains. Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in Solisia Landing.
