Close cooperation between H.E.R.M.E.S. and the biker is essential to pass the challenges. Once the challenge begins, H.E.R.M.E.S. moves automatically along the track. The biker controls the left and right movement to dodge obstacles and aim at enemies ahead.
During a match, light gates granting buffs appear along the track. Steer H.E.R.M.E.S. through them to collect these buffs (Up to 1 each time.)
Redundant system data manifests into enemies on the track. Shoot them down to claim buffs, or crash through them to clear the path. But crashing causes DMG equal to the enemies' remaining HP.
Special stages feature a boss enemy that stays on the track for a limited time, continuously attacking the biker with projectiles.
Defeating the boss grants Support Items with special buffs, which the biker can claim based on their current build.

Failing to defeat the boss before the countdown ends results in the boss crashing into the biker, dealing DMG based on its remaining HP. The challenge progress is saved after the boss is defeated and Support Items are claimed.
Elites are tougher enemies with higher HP. Defeat them promptly, or the biker will fail to dodge them and take damage.

In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Sustained Combustion Protocol. It fires projectiles that inflict a burning effect, continuously dealing damage to the target.
In this challenge, H.E.R.M.E.S.'s Support Droid is equipped with the Guided Missile Protocol. It automatically fires a guided projectile that locks and attacks the closest target.

Making a drink consists of four steps:
1. Select the first drink base.
2. Select the second drink base.
3. Select add-ins.
4. Select a topping.
The flavor of a drink depends on the combination of bases and add-ins you use, which also determines its type.

Long Cube Blockers (1×2) must be perfectly aligned with the Data Expansion Module to trigger its effect.

<color=#ffd12f>Laser Beam Modules</color> continuously fire laser beams. These beams can pass through <color=#ffd12f>Intangible Digital Shadow Modules</color> but are blocked by <color=#ffd12f>Tangible Modules</color>.

When a Cube Blocker comes into contact with the laser emitted by a
<color=#ffd12f>Laser Beam Module</color>, it will be instantly fused, causing the Smartprint Cube to reboot.

[About]
Outside the Mind Dive Arcade, a student named Tetoris beckons you to try the latest "Game of the Year," Lahai-Roi Blocks. The game has many wondrous properties, or so she claims...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14, and activate the Startorch Academy Resonance Nexus during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Rules]
A new stage will be unlocked each day during the event.
Each stage has two difficulties: Normal and Hard. Finish the Normal difficulty to unlock the Hard challenge.
Complete the goals of each stage to earn rewards.

[Endstate Matrix]
In Endstate Matrix, your skills will be tested through intense combats. Confront the enemies and earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Eligibility]
Achieve at least 24 Crests in one phase of the Tower of Adversity and reach at least 3,500 points in one phase of the Respawning Waters: Torrents in Whimpering Wastes after 3.2 is released.

[Challenge Cycle & Phases]
Endstate Matrix progresses through Challenge Cycles. Each Challenge Cycle spans across multiple Challenge Phases, which reset with version updates. Rewards are offered independently for Challenge Cycles and Challenge Phases 

[Cycle Rewards - Doomsday Cycle]
The current Challenge Cycle is "Doomsday Cycle". Complete the Cycle Tasks and Challenge Tasks to earn Encrypted Data and unlock exclusive rewards. Encrypted Data will be cleared at the end of the Cycle.
- Cycle Tasks reset at the start of a new Challenge Phase. In Doomsday Cycle, you may earn up to 420 points of Encrypted Data via Cycle Tasks.
- Challenge Tasks update at each Challenge Phase and last for the duration of the Challenge Cycle. In Doomsday Cycle, you may earn 20 points of Encrypted Data via each Challenge Task and up to 180 points in total.

[Matrix]
Endstate Matrix consists of two Zones: Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion. Earn the required points in Stability Accords to unlock Singularity Expansion.

[Stability Accords]
You may deploy up to 3 teams. Defeat all enemies in one round to complete the challenge.

[Singularity Expansion]
There is no limit to the number of teams you can deploy. Defeating all enemies in a round will open the next round, with enemies growing stronger each time.

[Power Circuits]
In Endstate Matrix, you must deploy three Resonators in each team and select a Power Circuit before starting the challenge.

[Demo Resonators]
Demo Resonators are available only if you own the corresponding Resonators. Each Demo Resonator is set to Lv. 90, equipped with a Lv. 90 weapon and a fitting Echo set with Lv. 25 Echoes. They inherit the Resonance Chain from your own Resonators.

[Resonator Enhancements]
In Endstate Matrix, certain Resonators will receive special skill enhancements.

[Viral Infection]
In Singularity Expansion, enemy HP increases by each round, and stronger enemy effects will be unlocked as rounds progress.

[Vigor]
Each time a Resonator participates in a challenge, 1 point of Vigor is consumed. Resonators with 0 Vigor cannot be deployed. Vigor is calculated separately for Stability Accords and Singularity Expansion.

[Weapon & Echo Occupation]
Different Resonators cannot use the same weapon and Echo in this event. If a Resonator in the team has equipped a weapon or Echo used by another Resonator with a challenge record, you cannot start the challenge with this team.
During the exam, explore, defeat powerful foes, and repair Mechascouts across Lahai-Roi to earn plenty rewards including Astrites.

[Lineup]
Choose up to 3 Resonators to participate in each exam. Resonators cannot be changed while the exam is in progress.

[Saves]
You are free to leave and reattempt any point during an exam, at which your repair progress and GPA Levels will be saved, excluding the Interim GPA Levels.

Trial Resonators will be available during the exams.

Repair the Knights to raise your GPA Level and activate milestone buffs.
Opening chests and performing combat actions give you Interim GPA Level that activates buffs temporarily.
Your Interim GPA Level will be cleared after you leave the instance or the combat state.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and obtain access to the expedition motorbike during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands."

[Event Rules]
1. During the exam, explore, defeat powerful foes, and repair Mechascouts across Lahai-Roi to earn plenty rewards including Astrites.
2. Raise your GPA Level by defeating enemies or repairing Mechascouts. A buff can be activated every 25 levels.

[GPA Level]
Defeating enemies around the Grand and Common Knights for the first time grants GPA Level EXP.

[About]
Enter the world of the Stellar Orbit Beats and pilot your spacecraft through the boundless universe.
Press buttons to the beat in a music face-off with other Resonators.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock (for the best experience, please complete this event's preceding quest "Gold Suspended in Shadows").

[Rules]
1. You can access the event via the Stellar Orbit Beats machine in the Mind Dive Arcade or through the Event Page. Pilot your spacecraft alongside other Resonators and hit the notes in time with the music to complete the track. A stage is completed once the spacecraft completes its journey.
2. Fly through space and press the buttons to the beat! Hit the Notes at the right timing to earn Stage Points. Reach the goals for each stage to unlock rewards.
3. Based on your final score, you will receive a Stage Rating of SSS, SS, S, A, or B. A stage will not be finalized if you quit mid-way.
4. Each music track has 3 difficulties: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Easy and Normal are unlocked by default. Hard is unlocked after completing the goals on Normal difficulty.
5. You can team up with unlocked Companion Resonators to challenge a stage together. Each Companion Resonator has their own skills that provide unique buffs.
6. Each track's Hard difficulty features a Friend Ranking leaderboard. Think you've mastered the beats? Compete with your friends for the top spot!
7. Any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your in-game mailbox automatically if you log in within 30 days after the event ends.

To every Rover who's walked this long road with us, thank you for being here.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
Log in during the event period to claim the rewards.
Rewards for this event will NOT be reissued via in-game mail once the event ends. Please pay close attention to the event time and claim the rewards beforehand.

[About]
The night sky over Lahai-Roi is a faithful scribe, bearing record of every star that has ever burned against the dark.
Now, under its watchful gaze, a graduating student is about to embark on his journey across the Dimmr Plains...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter III Act V "Starlights from Yesterdays" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
- Explore areas according to the clues to collect the scattered Chrono Traces.
- Collect all Chrono Traces to receive Astrites and other rewards.
- More Chrono Traces will be available for collection in other areas in the future.

[About]
To encourage the Pioneers to further share their explorations of the Roya Frostlands, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves! Participate and upload your Adventure Logs to get various rewards!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and activate the Resonance Nexus in Startorch Academy during the Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
- During the event, complete event tasks once per day to obtain a set number of Adventure Logs.
- Each Adventure Log can be exchanged for an Adventure Package. Adventure Packages contain special mechanics that, when triggered, unlock a large amount of rewards.
- There are 3 Inventories for the Adventure Packages. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

[About]
Beneath Lahai-Roi, the Solvein Heartwood towers overhead, as though holding up those long, shadowed ages. Innumerable motes drift here like traces of a past not yet extinguished, ancient and silent, waiting for an answer. Follow the light downward, and amid layers of dust, listen as those bygone days begin to wake.

[Eligibility]
Reach the Grand Architect's illusion during Main Quest "Wishes in the Bell" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
- The event is divided into four phases, each unlocking as you progress through the Main Quest. Complete event tasks to earn generous rewards.
- If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
- Please note that certain content of the event is not available while in Co-op mode, and Quest Tracking is not available while in certain areas of the quest.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 5.

[Event Rules]
Complete Spindrift Tasks to earn Spindrifts, which can be exchanged for various items in the Bountiful Waves.
Spindrift Tasks include Activity Tasks and Convene Tasks:
- Featured Resonator Convene tasks can be completed through Featured Resonator Convene. Weapon Convene tasks can be completed through Featured Weapon Convene. Some tasks can be completed multiple times. Please note that the Convene tasks above cannot be fulfilled through other ways, such as New Voyage Resonator Convene or New Voyage Weapon Convene.
- The Lustrous Tide consumption tasks can be completed through Standard Resonator Convene, Standard Weapon Convene, Novice Convene, or Beginner's Choice Convene.
(All Convenes made after the Version 3.3 update will count toward task progress.)

[Important Notes]
Spindrift Task and Bountiful Waves are both limited-time events, and their event duration may differ. Please pay close attention to their schedules.
- If the Spindrift Task ends but the Bountiful Waves is still available, any unclaimed Spindrifts will be automatically claimed upon login.
- If you log in within 30 days after the Bountiful Waves has ended, unused Spindrifts will be automatically converted into Shell Credits at a rate of 1:1000.
- If you log in after that 30-day period, any unclaimed Spindrifts will no longer be claimable, and any remaining Spindrifts will be cleared. Please pay attention to the event period and participate in the event accordingly.

Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy

[About]
The Somnoire gateway suddenly appears in Lahai-Roi, along with a bizarre, tangled dreamscape. Somehow, you even see Namipon in the midst of this chaos...

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and unlock the Resonance Nexus of the Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands."

[Event Rules]
1. After the event begins, speak with Namipon at Startorch Academy to accept the quest and start the challenge.
2. The challenge features three "Surface of Illusions" stages and one "Depth of Illusions" stage. Before entering, you can adjust the reward rate via Memetic Tuning. Higher rates yield greater rewards. Clearing stages earns you Illusive Specimen and Memory Points.
3. Illusive Specimens can be used to exchange for Astrites and other rewards. 
4. Spend Memory Points in Thought Revolution to upgrade your abilities, making future challenges easier.
4. Collect powerful boosts such as Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, and Resonator Enhancements as you venture through the Somnoire. Build the ultimate combination to conquer the deepest reaches of the dreamscape.

※ You may explore the Illusive Realm with the following Resonators:
※ Resonators available: Luuk Herssen, Aemeath, Mornye, Lynae, Chisa, Qiuyuan, Galbrena, Iuno, Augusta, Phrolova, Lupa, Cartethyia, Ciaccona, Zani, Cantarella, Brant, Phoebe, Roccia, Carlotta, Camellya, Shorekeeper, Xiangli Yao, Zhezhi, Changli, Jinhsi, Yinlin, Jiyan, Calcharo, Lingyang, Jianxin, Verina, Encore, Rover: Aero, Rover: Havoc, Rover: Spectro, Buling, Lumi, Youhu, Yuanwu, Danjin, Sanhua, Mortefi, Taoqi, Aalto, Baizhi, Yangyang, and Chixia.
※ The selected Resonator's level, Resonance Chain, and weapon will be carried over in the Illusive Realm, but their Echo stats and Echo skill will not.
※ The selected Resonator's Outfit will not be displayed in certain screens while exploring the Illusive Realm.

Clearing the Anomalies Around Voidbane Eldertrees
Restoring the Growth of Voidbane Eldertrees

<color=#ffd12f>Four rare ancient plant specimens known as Voidbane Eldertrees</color> are waiting to be restored. But Void Storms sweep through the Dimmr Plains year-round, and the trees remain stunted by Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies.
You must first work with the Survey Team members and the Soliskin to clear the <color=#ffd12f>Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies</color> around the Voidbane Eldertrees.

The factors hindering the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees have been removed, but after prolonged exposure to Voidmatter, the plants have entered an adaptive dormant state...
<color=#ffd12f>Deliver the corresponding area's "Restoratives"</color> to restore the growth of the Voidbane Eldertrees.

Restoratives can be obtained in large quantities from the <color=#ffd12f>recommended tasks and challenges within the corresponding sectors</color>.
In addition to recommended tasks, it can also be obtained from <color=#ffd12f>quests, challenges, and Supply Chests</color>.
You can also check which activities drop this item in the <color=#ffd12f>Exploration Progress</color> page.

Once the Restoration is completed, the Voidbane Eldertrees will resume growth, using their own energy to <color=#ffd12f>form bridges linking nearby survey sectors</color>.
It will also create <color=#ffd12f>support mechanisms</color> within the corresponding survey sectors.

Each completed Restoration grants the rare research specimen: Prism Fruit.
Deliver it to <color=#ffd12f>I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp</color> for analysis to advance the survey and <color=#ffd12f>expand the Base Camp</color>.

Once all Restorations are complete, all Prism Fruits have been delivered, and the <color=#ffd12f>Base Camp has been upgraded to Level 5</color>, the Solvein Heartwood's energy overflow will become even more pronounced, and the Dimmr Plains ecosystem will revive once more.

There are many mysterious caves throughout the Dimmr Plains. Interact with the Light Builder at a cave entrance, then rotate the Exostrider components inside until the projection matches the pattern on the wall to open the cave.
Voidcreeps release Voidmatter to erode the surrounding environment. Entering the affected area will continuously drain HP and restrict movement.

Lumescribe Components can suppress Voidmatter and cleanse Voidcreeps. A Voidcreep's tendrils exposed to light will close up, and its main body will shrink and explode after prolonged exposure.
Standing within a Lumescribe Component's range protects you from the Voidcreeps. The Voidcreep tendrils in the area will only disappear after all Voidcreeps in the area have been removed.

Attack or use the Hoverdroid to shoot the Solvein Heartwood Branch to activate a Lumescribe Component. It can also be activated by the light from another Lumescribe Component.
Interact with a Lumescribe Component to move it between rails.
Sometimes obstacles will block the light from a Lumescribe Component. Attack the obstacle to destroy it.
While standing within a Lumescribe Component's range, your Hoverdroid is empowered. Use it to deal a deadly blow to enemies.

The Reactor Drive energy within the Stalaglow Cavern is being eroded by Voidmatter. Purification cannot be completed until the Threnodian creations have been driven off.
Use Lumescribe Components to drive away the Threnodian creations. If the illuminated target is a clone, the clone will be destroyed. If it is the real body, the real body will be shot down.
When you approach a Royan rune fragment, the rune carved by Sigrika will react. Casting the selected rune power allows you to see the rune fragments scattered throughout the area.
Align the scattered rune fragments with the runes on the stone to reveal the complete rune.

A special monster left behind in the Voidthirst Cradle. It seems to have no physical form and cannot be attacked or destroyed.
It will relentlessly pursue intruders and drag them into the void, but remains completely still while being observed.
When you see Voidmatter contamination effect at the edge of the screen, she is getting close. Press the button to turn around quickly at such moments.
Aligning the main body and its reflection triggers resonance, releasing a directional beam that activates nearby mechanisms.

Soliskin Platform is created when Soliskin energy is released through a scientific instrument once contaminated by Voidmatter.
The platform itself is made of unstable Soliskin energy. As you move across it, the unstable platform tilts toward your position.
Soliskin Platform still obeys the laws of light and cannot pass through opaque objects.

When the platform is tilted at the proper angle, you can ask Hiyuki to freeze the Soliskin Platform beneath your feet. A frozen platform temporarily stops tilting.
Use the frozen platform to reach higher ground and continue forward.

A branch of the Solvein Heartwood. It seems to still bear traces of Exostrider creations and can store a small amount of Soliskin energy.
Try striking it to awaken the Soliskin energy within, which can be guided to and reactivate the nearest abandoned mechanics.
The Dimmr Plains are abound with such abandoned mechanics: Lumescribe Emitter, Lumescribe Component, and Soliskin Platform.
Dodge the falling blocks and climb upward using the path they form. First things first, catch up to Denia.
In Voidmatter Blocks, you must dodge the falling blocks until the countdown ends to win the game.

Before a block falls, it will track horizontally above you for a limited time. You can rotate the block by 90 degrees with the Rotate button.
Once you are in the right position, you can manually drop the block.

While dodging the blocks, be careful not to let the stack rise beyond the ready zone. If it does, the game will also fail.
When Voidmatter Blocks fill an entire row, that row is cleared, reducing the stack height.

A special plant found in the Dimmr Plains. Use the Projector to blow it away for a possible surprise reward.

The Race Page shows all stages of the Race and who's advancing.
The Race consists of 3 stages: Preliminary, Eliminator, and the Final. Each stage has a different schedule structure, which can be viewed in detail on the Race Page.
During the Support Phase, the current Contenders and match will be highlighted. After each match ends, the page will update to show which Contenders advance to the next match.

Some matches have the 1st and 2nd rounds. A Cube's ranking in the 1st round will determine its starting position in the 2nd round.
The number of advancement slots varies by match. Cubes that fail to advance will end their run after competing in a Showmatch.
After each match, you can view its replay in the Race Recap page or go directly to Support for the next match.

The screen flickers, accompanied by a burst of static, before cutting back to the news studio.

"It seems we've run into some issues with the feed from our correspondent. "(Yawns)... How long was I asleep...? You say something, Chixia?"
"Chixia? Who's Chixia? My full name is Flame Ranger—Tch, ow! I'm still sore there..."
You remember the hint from that *piece of paper*. It appears that you're already inside a "movie."

A fight scene flashes through your head...
You recall yesterday's attack. One which you successfully stopped from turning into a terrible disaster.
"That's the third attack this month... What are those things, anyway? Any ideas, {PlayerName}?"
"Tacet... Discords? Never heard of 'em. Well, whatever those things are, if they dare show their ugly faces again, I'll send 'em right back to wherever they came from..."
"WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—" Your conversation is interrupted by the wail of an ambulance screeching past you.
"Hey, hey, quit looking at me like that! I get it, alright? But I'm fine. I became Flame Ranger to protect the smiles, not let anyone shed tears on my watch. You think I'm gonna let that happen?"
"Still, you should probably get that wound from yesterday checked at the hospital."
"Oh, that? It's almost as good as new! Just a little scratch, patched it up myself."
"Wait, you're not scared of going to the doctor, are you?"
"WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—WHEEEEEEEEOOOO—" In the brief silence, the ambulance's shrill wails gradually fade into the distance.
"Alright... If you're so worried, let's head to the hospital right now! Might as well check on those poor folks from yesterday while we're at it."

"This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, and community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"

You arrive at what appears to be a train station. Inside the steel behemoth, the air is thick with the clamor of people coming and going and the constant murmur of the PA system blaring the same message on a loop. Truth be told, you've never seen this many bodies packed together, not even during the Carnevale in Ragunna...
Suddenly, a girl with a familiar blue hat stops you in your tracks.
"Hello. I am the Public Security officer on duty. May I see your identifications, please? ...Hmm? You're the girl from the accident scene earlier..."
"Huh? Isn't this Yangyang? What's up with this Public Security officer thing?"
"It's probably something similar to a Patroller..." You whisper, keeping your voice low. Abby responds with a puzzled nod.
"Oh, hey! If it isn't my favorite officer! Here's my ID."

"Mm... In light of recent incidents, we're conducting security checks at all points of entry... for the safety of the public." After verifying your IDs, the officer gestures for you to proceed. "Your IDs are in order. Thank you for your cooperation."
"Incidents. You mean those freaky monsters causing all the chaos, right?"

"Yes. We still haven't figured out the pattern or logic behind their movements. All we know is that they attack anything on sight." The officer frowns as if recalling the incidents from the past days.

"We have to treat this with the utmost caution. Places like the train station, the business districts, and Central Hospital are packed with people. If something happens, we Public Security officers are the first line of defense."
"Being an officer sure is tough... Wouldn't it be great if Flame Ranger could swoop in every time and save the day?"
"This Flame Ranger... the one from yesterday's incident?" It's clear that the name has caught the officer's attention.
"What do you make of this Flame Ranger, Officer?"
"Flame Ranger... She's shown up during multiple crises... From her actions, it seems she's either a masked hero or a vigilante."
"You mean the legendary Ally of Justice?"
"Justice...? Her abilities are disturbingly similar to those of the unidentified lifeforms. For the sake of public safety, I'm afraid I can't condone someone like that living in the city."
"If we just accept what she's doing, what happens if one day she loses control and turns into one of those mindless creatures?"
"Phew. She's got her hands full, huh? See? I told you being an officer is tough."
A sudden burst of noise erupts from a nearby crowd. You turn to glimpse a massive creature emerging from the shadows between buildings.
A shadow in the shape of a bird cuts across your vision—the officer with the blue hat. Weapon drawn, she leaps forward, rushing straight toward the fleeing crowd.
"Everyone, get back! Now! Move this way and remain calm!"
"I'm with Public Security. Follow my lead and evacuate the building to my left!"
"See, what did I just tell ya... Wait, where are you going?"
"To help her, duh! I'm not letting her fight that thing by herself!"
Together, you successfully repel the monster's attack and ensure all citizens are evacuated. But just as quickly, new monsters emerge from the shadows.
A nagging sense of déjà vu claws at you.
"This is no place for a civilian. How could you be so foolish and reckless!"
"I admire people like you, Officer. That's why I can't let you face this alone!"
"I don't want to see anyone crying because of these monsters. This city deserves to see smiles every damn day."
"What are you doing? Get back here!"
Flames burst from the girl's Tacet Mark and engulf her in blazing light. As the flames subside, a familiar figure stands before you.
"I trust you, Officer... And I hope you'll trust me, too. Keep this between the two of us, will ya?"
"The glowing star mark is my weak spot. So, if one day..." She hesitates, as if a memory flashes before her. She cuts herself off. "No. I can't. I promised someone I wouldn't turn into that."
"Oh, whatever. Overthinking isn't my style. Flame Ranger, roll out!"

You and Abby arrive at the clinical research department of Central Hospital, where the air is thick with the smell of medicine and disinfectants. The bustling atmosphere here rivals that of Huaxu Academy.
"From now on, refrain from using your powers. Is that understood?"

"Have I not made myself clear? Given your current physiological state, continued exposure to homologous influences could accelerate cellular degeneration or necrosis. Your body's organic components are diminishing, resulting in a metamorphosis towards a state resembling that of the unidentified lifeforms. Now, listen carefully. I do not concern myself with your aspirations to be the Flame Ranger or the Ally of Justice. However, you promised me that you'd avoid such a transformation. Do you not remember this?"
"Of course I do. You just gotta trust me."

"I do wish to place my trust in you, but your decisions directly contradict your stated objectives. If the current situation is allowed to persist, your excessive energy input and the influence of the homologous entities will push you toward a state that can no longer be classified as human. We are still in the preliminary stages of our research into these unknown phenomena, which means it is highly probable that this process is irreversible. Consequently, the very desire you expressed to eliminate the cause of people's tears caused by the unidentified lifeforms will become a lie. And your recklessness will force Officer Skylark to become the one who must terminate a friend. Or is this the outcome you foresee?
"Yup. Can't understand a word she's saying, no matter which version of Baizhi it is.."
"All right, all right, Doc... You don't have to make it sound so dramatic. Besides, a real hero doesn't go out that easily."

"Come on, is that really necessary? Did you see how much damage those freaks can do? What happens if you get hurt... Uh..."
"Okay, okay. You're giving me that look again. I get it. I'm not as hot-headed as you think... I'll get some rest."

"We interrupt with an emergency report. Just ten minutes ago, multiple reports came in regarding a large-scale attack by unidentified lifeforms in the Central Business District. "Good evening. We're currently standing in front of Midnight Square, with the second evacuation point just behind us, closest to the scene of today's devasting attack. The camera whirls in a chaotic spin, accompanied by screams and the sound of clashing metal. The broadcast cuts to black, with the last frame showing the officer rushing forward and pushing the reporter aside.
Abby points to the window and you notice that rain has begun to fall over the city.

"...Our correspondent seems to have encountered some technical difficulties. We repeat the advisory from Public Security: Citizens still within the exclusion zone should seek shelter and await rescue, or head to designated evacuation points for assistance..."
"That's our cue, {PlayerName}. We gotta get over there!"
"I need to go help those people. You saw the news!"
"I must remind you that your mutations have not fully recovered or been mitigated since your last interval. If you insist on going, all the promises you made to me will be in vain."
"I can't just stand here and do nothing. We know that officer on TV... I have to protect everyone. A hero can't just turn tail and run."

You force your way through the encroaching monsters, carving a path for the civilians and Public Security officers to escape, but the situation remains grim. The rain continues to pour, and monsters keep emerging from the fissure in the ground.

"What are you doing here? Get out of here, now! Can't you see this situation has spiraled out of control?!"
"This isn't a game. This is not the time for theatrics."
"You don't have to become the Flame Ranger. You're just an ordinary citizen who happens to have powers. You have no obligation to fight!"

"That's a bit too much for my brain, Officer. Gimme some time to process all that."
"To be honest, I've been scared. Ever since that big lecture Doc gave me. Scared that I might actually turn into one of these things."
"Right now, I feel... like I'm just glad I got to know all of you."
"Wait. What are you planning to do?"
"You said those things are called Tacet Discords, right, {PlayerName}? That they bring disaster and destroy civilizations."
"That makes it sound like humanity's fate has already been decided or something."
"But being a hero is my job. If that's all true, then I'll fight fate... And I'll win!"

Engage in the final battle to defend the city.

"This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else, and the most popular hero story ever. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"

The city's train station is as busy and crowded as usual, but unlike before, no officers are waiting to check your IDs today. On the sidewalk in the distance, a girl with a backpack hurries toward you.
"I'm here! Phew, made it. Sorry, I'm late... Hit a bit of traffic on the way."

"No need to worry. I've already accounted for your delay in the deviation margins. Current expectations remain within acceptable parameters. From there, we'll take the airport highway and maintain a speed that will ensure we arrive on time for the afternoon flight at the mere cost of a speeding ticket. The sole variable that remains is the uncertainty associated with the traversal time from the airport parking terminal to the acquisition of our boarding passes, followed by the security screening checkpoint..."
"Hold on. I don't think that's a valid reason for us to purposely risk a speeding ticket."
"What's a speeding ticket? Short for 'speed-eating ticket'? I bet I could bring that trophy home!"
"As good as it'll ever be! I'm in tip-top shape with one helluva appetite. I can still gobble down two servings of spicy beef hotpot if I wanted!"

Upon hearing spicy hotpot mentioned, you notice an annoyed expression on the researcher's face. "The health risks from your previous encounter still remain. "Um, Professor. I don't think that's what she meant..."
"Hehe. Hey, it stopped raining. Don't you guys think we should head out now?"
"The next train's gonna be leaving at twelve-thirty. We'd better get moving, or else we'll— " The girl swings her arms around in the shape of a clock, emphasizing the urgency of time ticking away.

And so, a hero's tale, full of familiar tropes and strange twists, quietly came to a close. Together, they set out on their journey to distant horizons. The weather after the rain was always pleasant. Just another ordinary day on a long road ahead.
As the laughter and chatter fade, the world before you blurs and dims... The strange third-person perspective slips away, and you find yourself once again seated in the theater.

As you take the Starflower brooch, you sense a faint but comforting frequency radiating from it.

The woman holding the umbrella greets you with an unhurried wave through the swirling snow. The hooded girl beside you hesitates, then nods slightly, as if recognizing her.
"We just gotta stay close to her and we don't have to feel the cold anymore...!"
"Hmm. And you are... I see. Even the best laid plans have flaws. There are more guests this year than I had expected." She smiles, seemingly unsurprised by your arrival.
"Well, then, travelers from afar, I take it you've met quite a few Frontier folk on your journey up. Each strong with... opinions, shall we say?"
"Hmm. Then you must have heard their claims about the Divine Loong... What do you make of the situation in the Frontier?"
"Or rather... after everything you've seen, can you distinguish the truth from the false?"
You reflect on her words, sensing there's more beneath the surface.
"Each side only sees the truth they want to see... Or rather, the truth itself doesn't really matter to them."

"It seems you've learned to piece together the truth from fragments." She glances at the hooded girl. "However... she too has never revealed her identity nor her intentions, and yet you still choose to join her on this journey?"
Though you haven't asked, you're long been certain of the hooded girl's identity. You nod with confidence.
"Why does it feel like everyone speaks in riddles around here?"
"Anyway, {PlayerName} said it's actions that count, not intentions. She's fought beside us and led us up the mountain for treasure. I'd say she's a friend we can trust!"
"Judge actions not intentions... I never expected to hear those exact words again on this mountain after sixteen years."
"Very well, then... As promised, it's time to test your strengths."
She throws her paper umbrella into the air, and with a loud bang, it explodes into a fiery bird that scatters the snow around it.
"...Sixteen years. A mere blink of an eye."
As the fiery energy of the bird fades, it transforms back into the paper umbrella and returns to the woman's hand. The blizzard swiftly covers the scorch marks and puddles left behind.
You barely notice the transformation. The whole time, your eyes are fixed on the girl's exposed face as her hood slips away.
Silver hair, a mole beneath her right eye, scales marking her skin... And Loong horns sprouting from her forehead. It's no wonder she wears a hood.
This isn't the first time you've seen her like this.
"I-It's Jinhsi! No wonder her voice sounded so familiar. It all makes sense now!"
"Wait, {PlayerName}. Did you know it was her all along? Am I the only one who didn't realize?"
The girl reaches for her hood and catches your gaze. With a bitter smile, she lowers her hand.
"Forgive me, I wasn't intentionally hiding my identity. The situation demands discretion. Though I am worshipped as the Divine Loong, revealing the truth to the people proves difficult."
"You mean... you're the Divine Loong? But doesn't that... Wait, isn't it... Umm... no, wait, or is it...?"
"Illusions arise when causes and conditions meet, then vanish when they part."
"You knew what they sought from the start. So why do you persist?"
"Whether I explain or not, people will interpret as they wish. Everyone chooses the truths they want to believe... even I am no exception..." She says, pausing for a brief moment.

"I only sought to make choices I wouldn't regret. If perfection wasn't possible, I believed protecting the majority was the right path. But those choices become betrayals to those sacrificed. Who is sacrificed, who deserves it, and who has the right to decide... For the one making such a choice, weakness is unforgivable."
"Only through absolute strength can one refuse to choose at all. To fulfill this conviction, my methods may seem extreme, but they're necessary."
"...I am no longer the person I was when I first left this mountain. There's so much in the world... how can anyone really know what's right or wrong in everything?"
Her philosophical tone creates an odd disconnect, making you feel as though you've missed something important.
"Good golly, {PlayerName}. I understand every word, but when you put 'em together it makes zero sense to me!"
"Feels like everyone's just saying things without saying anything, huh?"
"I understand. Since your resolve remains unwavering, I will speak no more on this matter."
"As for you, traveler from afar... Your confusion is understandable. As her companion, it is customary to grant you access to the Loong Chamber. Soon, all will become clear."
The woman with the umbrella steps closer, placing a finger to her lips and shaking her head with a knowing smile.
"Throughout this journey, I've observed each of you. Now, the responsibility of bearing witness falls to you."
"And as for everything we've discussed thus far... You may use the information you've gathered at your discretion when this is all over."
A brief silence settles over the group, save for Abby, who continues glance around in curiosity.
The silver-haired girl with horns gives you a bow before continuing her ascent toward the mountain peak.
As she completes the puzzle, the disc on the stone wall rotates clockwise, revealing a dark cave entrance.
"The final path to the Loong Chamber can be revealed by aligning the mechanism according to the spring star map of the Frontier's night sky."
"…If you ever travel there in the future, you'll be able to witness this night sky with your own eyes."
"Whoo-hoo! We made it! I can smell the treasure waiting for me!"

Rather than the decaying, crumbling ruin you anticipated, the Loong Chamber is surprisingly well-preserved, free of deadly traps or monstrous inhabitants. There are even traces of recent cleaning in some corners.
"The wicks on these lamps look like the ones in the temple..." Moving along a path surrounded by stone walls, the swordswoman examines the decorative elements.
"Was someone living here? What exactly is this place...?"
"Venturing deeper without caution wouldn't be wise. I suggest we rest here for a moment. A difficult battle likely awaits us."
"As for what's ahead... If I may, I prefer to go alone. I'll return once I've activated all the mechanisms within the Chamber, then we'll move forward together."
"It's better this way. I'm sure you've noticed it by now, haven't you, {PlayerName}?"
Turning back at the passage's turn, the lamp in her hand casts a glow on the scales along her cheeks and neck.
"Though our time together in the tempest has been brief, it's given me a feeling like none other. I've never met anyone so similar to myself until now."
"How reassuring it is to know there's someone like me. Now, no matter what awaits at the end of this journey, it won't feel as daunting."
"Thank you, {PlayerName}. I'll leave the rest in your capable hands."
Raising the lamp, she walks away without looking back.
With little light in the Loong Chamber, the darkness obscures the expressions of your companions.
Perhaps not long had passed, only the burn of a matchstick. Or rather a lonely candlestick, devoting its entire lifespan—
You notice someone holding a lamp approaching you from the direction you came. Her steps are steady, a warrior poised to pour all her passion into the coming battle.
"It took longer than I expected. What happened?"
"I was just about to charge in there and look for you!"
"I am fine. I appreciate your concern."
"Preparations for this battle took longer than I anticipated, that's all. The survival of the Frontier is at stake... there's no room for mistakes."
Her tone differs from her parting words. Though she attempts to remain candid, you sense a subtle distance in her words.
"We will eliminate the Loong dwelling within and gain the power needed to protect the Frontier."
"I will protect you until the very end."
Following her lead, you navigate the vast, winding passages until suddenly the path opens up into a wide area.

Snowflakes drift down onto your shoulders once more. The final stretch of the Loong Chamber leads to the mountain's summit, where a Loong with blue and black scales, a white mane, and golden horns awaits.
You notice its labored breathing. The powerful yet unstable frequencies it emanates leak out like water from a cracked vessel. Only the creature's eyes remain calm, locking with yours.
How long did it take for it to return?
After all those years, any trace of joy or sorrow has long since faded, swallowed by the endless snow.

The tea on the table hisses at it boils. In the inn's lobby, the troublemakers from earlier are still sitting across from each other, silently locked in a standoff. At the counter, the innkeeper flips through his account book, nodding in approval at the compensation totals.
Sunbeams slice through the air to catch dust particles that float like whispers. The corner where the hooded girl once sat is now empty.
"When do you suppose Jinhsi's coming back, {PlayerName}?"
"She made us a promise. All we need to do is wait."

"You know, I didn't expect that the Loong would just turn into frequencies and get absorbed by her like that... She already had horns when we met, right? So why did she grow new ones right after? Everything in this film is so weird, I feel like we're barely scratching the surface."
Abby slumps against your shoulder, showing no interest in the plate of wings on the table, muttering about the recent adventures.

After the battle at the mountain peak, you parted ways on the descent. The swordswoman returned to the temple, and the woman with the umbrella remarked, "We shall meet again in sixteen years," before disappearing without a trace.
Only the silver-haired girl agreed to meet you at the dock the following day to leave the mountain together.
You spent a day resting at the inn, but strangely, the image of the Loong's dying gaze continues to haunt you.
In an instant, her words while she held that lamp suddenly makes sense to you.
"The mountain will be sealed off in a few days... The place will be a ghost town by then. We'd better head out soon if we want to make it back."
"But what about the guys still up there? What are we gonna do... Are we supposed to go home empty-handed?"
A gloomy atmosphere settles over the inn. But it's soon shattered by the hurried footsteps of a Tong Sui vendor from the dock as he bursts though the door.
"The girl with the Loong horns showed up! I saw her! With my own eyes! She's left the mountain and is heading to the Frontier! She's at the dock right now!"
"You found the Divine Loong?! Move it, people! If we miss her, we might not get another chance!"
The inn erupts into commotion as everyone rushes out. You and Abby exchange a glance before quickly following.
Despite the large crowd, you immediately recognize her standing by the dock , giving a speech to everyone gathered around her.
You can't catch every word, but from her lips and the crowd's reactions, you know what she's doing. She isn't speaking for herself—she's uniting them.
You finally grasp the significance of her existence. In a world without saviors, people still need something to believe in to keep going.
Perhaps her refusal to compromise defines her journey. She drifts on currents of untraceable desires, choosing a path she sees as ideal, no matter the cost.
And so, every sixteen years, the same scene plays out on this mountain.
She smiles and guides you onto the small boat headed for the Frontier.
"You're not from the Frontier are you, {PlayerName}? Have you been there before?"
"I see... Growing up, I often heard stories from travelers. They said, in times of peace, the fields flourish with crops, and the lights from homes dance on the rivers."
"And on cloudless nights, if you look up, you'll see a river of stars stretching endlessly across the sky."
"Truth be told, I've never been there myself."
Following her gaze, the snow-capped mountains above the sea gradually fade into the falling snow. Her words take you back to the moment you first stood on the Central Plains, gazing back at Jinzhou.
"I've lived my entire life on this mountain, as far as I can remember. This... is the first time I've ever left."
"The world has never been so quiet."
"What do suppose it's like in the Frontier {PlayerName}? Will my powers... bring happiness to the people?"
"Perhaps. But if we ever manage to unite everyone... if we bring back that starlit sky..."
"We shall name that force, the Midnight Rangers."

The small boat sways gently, sailing into the vast whiteness. Everything before you becomes blurred and distant... The detached narrative fades, and you find yourself back in your theater seat once again.

"Long, long ago... Legends say a girl was raised by a Divine Loong, the ruler of wind, rain, and seasons. She grew up happily in the Loong Chamber."
"Her snow-covered home was bountiful, drawing many from the Frontier to travel and trade. She cherished the townsfolk's company, yearning to see the world beyond."
"But gradually, fewer came seeking blessings, and those who did wore troubled expressions. When she asked, they told her a devastating truth: monsters were ravaging their lands."
"Troubled, she approached her guardian: 'Those who once worshiped us now face hunger and ruin. Is there a way for me to save them?'"
"The Loong sighed, 'It is futile, child. You cannot change their fate, and neither can This One. It is the natural course.'"
"'I refuse to accept that,' she insisted. 'If by natural law, I should have perished in the wilderness long ago. Yet you changed my fate.'"

"Seeing her resolve, the Loong granted her powers of wind, rain, and seasons. With its final breath, it spoke, 'Do not mourn This One's passing. Our paths diverge. Remember, every gift bears a cost. The people offered tribute for good seasons, and This One fulfilled its duty. But now, This One denies them passage, for new promises lie beyond my power. In these troubled times, power becomes a curse. Should you falter, those who depend on you will suffer. They will not thank you, but will question and resent you... You remind This One of what I once was. This One accepts its end, yet cannot bear to watch you experience the same... and lose your faith.'"

"'I have no regrets,' the girl said, sorrow in her voice. 'Now, with you leaving my side, they are all I have. I cannot watch them perish. I will grow stronger, unmoved by hardship, betrayal, or anything that dares to break me.'"
"But the Loong only smiled softly. 'There is nothing wrong with fading away.' It vanished into the blizzard, leaving only a whisper in the wind."

"The Loong's words echoed in her mind. She began contemplating ways to overcome the inevitable. In time, wielding that power, she locked the mountain's flow of time to the sixteen years of her youth, severing the mountain from the rest of the world."

"After that, she journeyed to the Frontier, using her powers to protect the people and unite survivors against adversity. Sixteen long, brutal years passed, until she finally returned to the mountain. There, she would pass her power to her younger self, untouched by time."

"Thus, time within the mountain became like a pre-determined game of Weiqi. No matter how the world changed, the Divine Loong of the Frontier would never fall. When the old faded, the new would rise. There would always be a youthful, passionate version of her to uphold the ideal, fulfilling her promise to protect for eternity."

The tea on the table hisses at it boils. In the inn's lobby, the troublemakers from earlier are still sitting across from each other, silently locked in a standoff. At the counter, the innkeeper flips through his account book, nodding in approval at the compensation totals.
You set the empty dishes aside and nudge Abby, signaling that it's time to stop eating.
"Well then, what do you think of this story, pieced together as it is?"
It's very much what I imagined.
"An interesting story, yes. But it has its inconsistencies."

"Heh... True. The truth is unclear, and the story is riddled with questionable elements... But if there is no Divine Loong, then which came first, the girl with the power or the dragon that gave it to her?"
"...These are simply baseless rumors, nothing more. We need to leave soon. You should finish your meals."
"Once we return to the Frontier, who knows when we'll taste such delicacies again."
"That's right! You guys better eat up or I'm gonna finish the whole thing! {PlayerName} promised us a proper feast before we leave!"
"Indeed. 'Without attachments, there is no fear, no illusion, only the path to enlightenment.' For now, nothing matters more than the meal before us."
"Once we're back in the Frontier, we'll be caught up in duties. Though {PlayerName} might still manage to visit here from time to time."
"With the Temporal Disruption now stable, the mountain's connection to the rest of the world is restored, and local cuisine will be easier to access. However..."
"With time flowing in sync, prices here no longer match those of the outside world. The local currency is now a rare antique."
"Wait. Why is everyone looking at me like that? Are these dishes pricey? {PlayerName}, we found the Loong's treasure, right? Come on, think of something!"
"A-Ahem! I am immensely grateful for your aid these past few days. Consider this meal a gesture of my gratitude."
She rises and walks to the counter. After a brief exchange with the innkeeper, she retrieves a small pouch of coins taken from the Loong Chamber and settles the bill.
Now that the horns and scales are gone, no one would associate her with the legendary Divine Loong. She's simply a girl, smiling and blushing like any other.
She turns back with a smile. It's time for the ferry.
In truth, you didn't keep your promise to help her slay the Loong that day.
Right before the final blow, you hesitated, facing the silver-haired girl as confusion flickered across her face.
Slaying the Loong was not a difficult task. Her plan was flawless for those involved. After walking such a long, solitary path, she could not let the chance to realize her ideals slip away.
Killing the Loong could save everyone. Would they ever understand the immense resolve it took her to walk this desperate path?
Yet even so, the three of you were enough to stop her from ending the Loong's life. It was so close.
You respond to her question with one of your own.
To hold compassion for all means letting go of attachments and rising above emotion. But if one has truly abandoned emotion, can they truly say to another, "You are so similar to me"?

That's why the three of you came to an understanding before the Loong Chamber: no one is destined to be sacrificed, and no one has the right to decide who is sacrified. The sixteen-year cycle had to end.
The world exists in a turbulent stream. Can violence truly bring about goodness? Of all the ways to find salvation, only saving oneself is true.
—Your thoughts are interrupted by Abby's voice, pulling you back into the film. At the dock, the silver-haired girl waves from a boat.
It's about a girl who has no companions.
It's about the journey of a lonely savior.
"Is it... Well, I don't really get her thinking..."
"But I get what you're saying. If she'd had companions like us from the start, her journey would've been much easier, right?"
You gently ruffle Abby's hair with a smile and follow your companions onto the small boat heading for the Frontier.
What comes next will be a brand-new story.

"Enough! We've wasted too much time already. If the mountain closes, we'll be trapped here. Who will take care of the family back home?"
"...Have faith in the Divine Loong. Even if she only has sixteen years here, isn't that better than the uncertainty of life in the Frontier?"
"The immortal said everyone has their fate. Even if we never meet again, as long as she's safe, that will be enough..."
The temple gates swing open. Holding on to their child, the couple pleads desperately. After a moment of struggle, the woman reluctantly surrenders their child.
"Hua! Forgive me! I won't be there to watch you grow... From now on, you'll have to take care of yourself."
As they descend the stone steps, the couple turns back again and again, until they finally disappear into the endless white, leaving no trace behind.
A sudden cry shatters the silence.
She moves toward the fading mirage, almost against her will, unaware of the ominous presence lurking within the blizzard.
"I'm alright, thank you. Forgive my lapse." She composes herself with a deep breath.
"This mountain has its monsters and mirages... born of inner demons and obsessions, nothing more."
"All things are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows... as fleeting as dew or lightning. When one becomes too attached to the idea of who they are, vulnerability easily takes hold."

In the uneven flow of time, some things were left behind.
"I was simply caught off guard. Don't worry. I promised to escort you up the mountain, and I will see it through."
"I must warn you, there have been sightings of mirages formed by the  Divine Loong's unstable powers. Should you encounter them, hold true to your beliefs, and you will not lose your way..."
Have you ever thought about looking for them?
Did you ever visit that couple?
She hesitates for a moment, then shakes her head with a soft sigh.

This righteous person you're talking about, could it be...
That's the Jianxin I know all right...

"I never thought I'd run out of money and supplies before I could start my journey up the mountain... Now I have no choice but to sell these ancient scrolls until the day I can finally aid the Divine Loong."

"I know how it feels to be on an empty stomach. Been there."
"We're also heading up the mountain. You can join us if you like."

"...Won't even stand a chance against me. Of course... if you could spare a couple of Flatbreads, I'd be forever grateful..."

About Map Exploration
 
[Events]
There are various types of events on the map, each with the following effects:
Story Event: A mandatory event required to progress, including the main story and final challenge.
Battle Event: Engage in battle and earn Dream Fragments based on the battle's difficulty.
Random Event: Trigger different outcomes.
Recruitment Event: Spend Dream Fragments to recruit Resonators.
Respite Event: Restore Film Rolls.
 
[Film Roll]
Film Rolls are consumed by Battle Events, Random Events, and Story Events.
If you are defeated in a battle, use Film Rolls to restore your Resonators to their pre-battle state.
 
[Bond]
Bonds can be formed between certain Resonators, and a Resonator can hold multiple Bonds.
Bonds provide combat buffs that apply to all Resonators unless specified otherwise.
Bond Level is based on the Star Ratings of all Resonators sharing the same Bond.
Increase the Bond Level to unlock its unique Synergy Burst.

[Synergy Burst]

When Aero Resonators consecutively hit targets, they deal more damage.

Every time Havoc Resonators deal damage, the targets' Havoc RES is reduced.

For the biomechs that escaped their cages, becoming true beasts has always been their deepest desire. Unfortunately, they were created with far too much humanity and far too little savagery.
The biomechs attempted to pass the "wisdom" stored in their databases on to other creatures, but mutual understanding was never possible.
This is an age of machines, and a great one at that.
Some researchers believe biomechs are capable of appreciating "art." Most, however, insist that it is nothing more than algorithmic hallucination.
Now, with the hard-won freedom on the line, the biomechs stand ready for a desperate battle.
No one knows why the biomechs targeted the research funds. Perhaps an early trading system has formed among them. Or perhaps it was simply an attempt to disrupt the project.

[About]

At this year's Club Show & Tell, Van Tassie of the Psychological Threshold Alternative Therapy Society proudly unveils his latest project: the "F.U.E.L. Optimization Simulator." [Rules]

1. How to Play

Access the event from the Mind Dive Arcade machine or the Event Page. Control your Resonator to move left and right to catch falling food and earn Gourmet Points.

2. Energy & Skills

Catch food to build Energy. Once your Energy bar is full, you can activate a powerful Resonator Skill.
Be careful—catching certain negative foods will drain your Energy and slow you down.

3. Clearing a Stage

Reach the target Gourmet Points to earn 1 Star to clear the stage. Quitting the game midway will finalize this stage based on the Gourmet Points earned.

4. Stage Unlocks

Stage 1 is available when the event begins. A new stage unlocks each following day, each featuring a new Resonator with unique skills.

5. Rewards

If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.

[Rules]

1. During the event, 18 Cubes will take part in matches in 3 Groups. Not counting the Final, 1 match takes place per day with 14 matches in total to decide the Ultimate Race Winner.
2. The entire competition is comprised of 3 Stages: Preliminary, Eliminator, and the Final. Please refer to the event schedule for specific times and dates.
3. Between the end of the previous match till half an hour before the next match starts (20:30 server time), you can support your favorite Cube by predicting the Match Winner of the day.

[About]
Startorch Academy and the Roya Tribe have joined forces to establish a foothold on the Dimmr Plains, launching a joint scientific expedition into this long-isolated realm. Objectives include collecting environmental data, recovering ancient plant samples and Exostrider components, and remediating environmental damage caused by Void Storms. The fruits of this operation will effectively advance ecological research and habitat restoration in Lahai-Roi.
You receive a message from I.R.I.S., inviting you to join the inaugural expedition...

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest "Starlights from Yesterdays" to unlock.

[Rules]
What appears to be an entirely new species of ancient trees has been discovered across four sectors of the Dimmr Plains. The Department of Light Energy Sciences has officially named them Voidbane Eldertrees. Due to the combined effects of the Solvein Heartwood and Void Storm contamination, these specimens have become stunted and irregular in their growth. The expedition team has developed a plan to restore them to full health.

Work with the Survey Team members to clear Voidmatter contamination and other anomalies within the sectors to complete the necessary preparations.

The required material, "Restoratives," can be obtained through each sector's exploration tasks and challenges. Deliver the required quantity of Restoratives for a sector to restore its Voidbane Eldertree.

Complete Restoration of a tree grants you rare Prism Fruits, which can be delivered to I.R.I.S. at the Base Camp to advance exploration progress and expand your base.

Once you have completed all Restoration activities across the Dimmr Plains and upgraded the Base Camp to Level 5, the energy flow from the Solvein Heartwood will be intensified, making the Dimmr Plains shine once more.

The Vanguard Junrock mainly uses melee attacks. Dodging its attacks causes it to rush into the ground and be temporarily immobilized.
Fission Junrock can heal nearby allies. Prioritize it in combat.
The Electro Predator shoots a rain of arrows towards its target, dealing DoT Damage within a certain range and duration.
After the "javelin" from the Glacio Predator lands, it will explode after a certain period of time, causing unexpected damage to the enemies.
The throwing weapon of the Aero Predator is capable of tracking its enemies. Be careful of its trajectory, otherwise you may suffer serious damage.

Fusion Warriors can defend and bounce off close range attacks received from the direction they're facing, and will immediately thrust at the enemy if the bounce is successful. However, the thrust attack can be parried with Counterattacks.
When facing the Havoc Warrior, you need to pay attention to dodging its fast, mid-range dash attack.

When Snip Snap is defeated, the residual Thermo energy within its body can trigger an explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind a Fusion Energy Circle that deals DoT Damage to players within the circle.

When Zig Zag is defeated, the residual Spectro energy within its body can trigger an explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind a Diffusion Energy Circle that slows the Resonators within the circle.

When Whiff Whaff is defeated, the residual Aero energy within its body can trigger a explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind a Storm Eye that continues to drag players inward and deals DoT Damage to players within the range.

When Tick Tack is defeated, the residual Fusion energy within its body can trigger an explosion, which can be interrupted by a timely attack. Once the explosion is successful, it will leave behind an Havoc Energy Circle, reducing the Resonance Energy of the Resonator within the circle and dealing DoT damage.

Hoartoise will be turned upside down if attacked by plunge attack, immobilized temporarily.
Young Fusion Dreadmanes can cleverly dodge enemy attacks even before attacks are made, though this doesn't work every time.

Stonewall Bracer will use its left hand to defend when being attacked. At this stage its left hand can be broken by repeated attacks, forcing it to change tactics. But once it begins to rage, the broken left hand will be recovered.

Herons regain all of its health after devouring Cluster Prisms, befor e entering an empowered state of the element of the Prism devoured. Under this state the Herons will launch more powerful attacks.

Though Flautist may be the first to appear in front of players, they will not attack directly. Instead, they always play a tune to turn their allies into rage. If a Flautist is under attack, it will try to flash and escape as soon as it catches the breath between attacks.
Tambourinists can play a tune to create energy spheres of Havoc eEnergy to hinder players' actions.
The Tacecrux on the chest of the Rocksteady Guardian is its weak spot. Use pistols to deal satisfactory damage.

Use a pistol to strike the Tacetrite core on the Geohide Saurian's back. This will inflict a great shock on it, putting it in a paralyzed state.
The Tacetrite core on the top of mature Roseshroom is actually a taunt to fool its enemy. Its real weakness is the center of its Tacetite head. Attacking this position with pistols can disable it.

Rupture Dreadmanes can cleverly dodge enemy attacks even before attacks are made, though this doesn't work every time. When endured with enough damage, Dreadmanes will enter an enraged state and can encourage its nearby companions with its howl. At the same time, its own attacks will generate additional Havoc Energy infused crystals for long-range attacks.

Hoochiefs are usually found in groups, and their minors will join along in fights, but minors tend to flee and play dead after taking some damage. At this point, if there are adults nearby, younger individuals will be stopped from fleeing and inspired to rejoin the fight.
Spearback's front paws are covered with Tacetite, providing extremely strong physical durability.
The Carapace will chase its prey for a long time over vast distances. Therefore, it is advisable to eliminate it at the earliest sighting of its tracks to evade any potential danger.
After taking a certain amount of damage, the Exile Leader will have a significantly increased desire to attack due to pain and anger.
Exile Technicians can protect their fellow members with shields and strengthen the shield further after they take a certain amount of damage.

Executioners who have suffered some injuries will be keenly aware of the dangers on the battlefield and will unleash their true potential - They fade away into the darkness, slowly approach their prey, and strike.
Fractsidus Thruster is not agile. Circling around it will confuse it. But too much circling will enrage it and lead it to perform an angry strike back. It may jump and smash the ground.

Thundering Mephis will usually test its enemy through constant flash attacks at the beginning of the battle. These attacks can be repelled with Counterattacks. A successful Counter will immobilize it. Once it stops the testing, it will engage in close range attacks. At this stage, well-timed Counterattacks can abort its attacks.

Inferno Rider would put its mount's flexibility into good use for charging and rapid slashing. Be careful with its blade attack. If it abandons its ride and gets close, Counterattack will be a good tool to fend it.
Herons are capable of consuming Cluster Prisms of any attribute.

This Tacet Discord relies on the ground cocoons to sustain its flight. When flying, it utilizes fluorescent light to locate its target and launch long-range attacks. Destroying the ground cocoons can make it fall to the ground. Attacking The Tacecrux at its tail, another weak spot, can also knock it down.
Feilian Beringal uses the pillar trapping it as its weapon. So the pillar is at the same time the threat and the weakness. Attacking the pillar may have unexpected result.

The Mourning Aix can "grab" the invader with "both hands" and deal a large amount of damage. Launching Counterattacks can force the creature to release its grip. Similar to other Tacet Discords, the Tacecrux on its chest is its fatal weakness.

The Crownless does not immediately engage its opponent at the beginning of the battle. Rather, it prefers to test the opponent's strengths and weaknesses. By taking hits, it will gradually figure out the opponent's attack pattern and begin to evade. Once it has fully engaged, most of its attacks can be parried with Counterattacks.
The shell of the Bell-Borne Geochelone seems indestructible. Only the ancient bell on its back has a few cracks present. Perhaps the key to defeating it lies beneath the bell.

When Changli arrived in Jinzhou, Jinhsi was still in her youth, and the region was in dire straits.
No one knew how she managed to juggle the interests of various factions and push forward progress across all sectors with a limited budget.
It was said that Changli avoided electronic media during this time, instead recording notes in a booklet. To this day, people continue to search for this elusive booklet, hoping to uncover the secrets of Jinzhou's past. However, no one has ever succeeded, and there's no evidence to even confirm its existence.

Once in a moment of despair, Sanhua witnessed a golden snowfall, dazzling like petals cascading from the heavens.
Drawn to the sight, she forgot her pain and predicament.
Only later did she realize they were actually fallen Bodhi blossoms.
To this day, that ethereal scene enchants her dreams, where swirling snow transforms into a golden deluge of petals. These dreams bring her solace, giving her the strength to face her anomalous visions with calm determination.

In Jinzhou, Mortefi is the creative force behind 80% of popular children's toys and entertainment facilities. From the Spinning Bloop to the Swinging Loongboat and the Sabyrboar Scooter, his designs always captivate young minds. Surprisingly, he doesn't charge any patent fees for these designs. 

For Mortefi, it's not about money; it's about seeing the joy, wonder, and admiration in children's eyes. 

Or perhaps, it's a way for him to recapture his own lost childhood.

Ali, a classmate of Chixia's, once described to her how poignant their migration was: a time marked by relentless disruptions from the Tacet Discords, when hunger forced them to eat grass or tree bark. Yet, Chixia also remembers savoring this green grass cake, always roasted crusty and seasoned with spicy sauce. It remains a delightful treat etched in her memory.
When she asked her mother about their journey to Jinzhou after school, her mother playfully responded that it was a story open to Chixia's imagination.

It serves as the shadowy pawn of unseen adversaries and heralds the onset of ceaseless woes of war.

Windchimers are scattered across Mt. Firmament and can be collected by striking them.

A remnant creature with an intense obsession with music. When struck, it drops the Melody Box it has collected.
