What's the difference between a coconut-flavored urchin and an urchin-flavored coconut? Nevertheless, one thing's for sure: both hurt like a charm when they hit your head.

It is a common belief among the Riccioli fishers that the crystal cavities on Cetus the Tidebreaker were pierced by a crew of godless sailors, incurring divine wrath. Then, the fragments of the shattered crystals transformed into the Black Pearls—though Captain Ahab firmly dismisses this tale as fanciful nonsense.

A variant of the Gulpuff, often found near the Riccioli Islands. Unlike its docile cousin, the Bampuff is highly aggressive and is used to make "Sweet Puff."
During the day, a threatened Bampuff will explode, dragging predators—or even fishing boats—into mutual destruction. At night, however, it can be fished like any ordinary catch.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.

A type of flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.

A type of tree log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a kind of rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.

Metal debris found in the Riccioli Islands territory. Despite being eroded by the sea, it's still usable as rough material.
Upon returning to the dock, it will be automatically processed into materials at a set ratio and stored in the Stash.
As is well known, octopuses don't naturally grow inside clams. These small octopuses actively seek out suitable clams, devour the original residents, and claim the shells as their new homes.

During their brief breeding season, Bell Crabs shed their iconic bells in search of mates. Fishers humorously call them "Bell-less Crabs" during this time. Their meat is said to become exceptionally flavorful, attracting food enthusiasts from Ragunna eager to savor this seasonal delicacy.
Found across Solaris, this fish occupies a mid-tier position in the food chain. It is known for its ability to leap out of the water and glide for short distances.
True to its name, this jellyfish resembles and tastes like a fried egg. It is one of the largest exports of the Riccioli Islands.
Are they fish? Yes, yes, they are. Did I finish them? No, no...

At a distance, it resembles a drifting vegetable leaf, but up close, it brings to mind the legendary ancient dragon of Rinascita. Despite their grand dreams of becoming the mighty Pelagic Wyrm, their tiny size dooms their ambition to stay only a fantasy.

Most biologists in Rinascita agree that "Rainbow Eel" would better suit this creature than "Yarn Eel" based on their vibrant appearance. However, due to their timid nature, these eels are often found tangling with one another for survival. While "a cluster of timid Rainbow Eels" might be accurate, "Yarn Eel" is far less of a tongue-twister.

This octopus might not pack much nutritional value, but its charm is off the charts. With a cute appearance and a soft, graceful body that dances through the water, it has won the hearts of Ragunna's noble ladies, becoming a sought-after ornamental pet.

In the Riccioli Islands, misbehaving children are often warned about the Giant Gulper, a deep-sea predator said to snatch naughty kids at night. While this creature fuels many childhood nightmares for the islanders, the Sob Blobs, as its helpless prey, truly live in its shadow.

In the lightless depths of the sea, these clustered salps are a common meal for many deep-sea creatures—except Giant Gulpers. It seems these predators find the salps too small to bother with. To date, there have been no reported sightings of Giant Gulpers chowing down on salps.
It sobs for its insignificance in the vast ocean and its vulnerability to the gaping maw of its predators.
The Pokey Moray once vowed to leave behind its slow-paced life—only for its ambition to be cut short the moment it ended up on your line.

Food, shelter, and fashion are no concerns for a Gooberstar. It spends its days lounging in carefree bliss, untouched by predators thanks to its unappetizing taste. Its life is nearly perfect—if only it could find a sponge to make things even better.

Armed with a coat of sharp thorns, a Pricklecrab is a bold and aggressive predator of the deep sea. One fisher is said to have fended off a Tacet Discord by hurling a Pricklecrab at it. A creature of great ferocity indeed.

Known as the "Sea Angel," this delicate creature is as enchanting as a butterfly fairy. Many believe it serves as the envoy of Cetus the Tidebreaker, tasked with retrieving lost souls from the ocean's depths. Yet, given its diminutive size, one can't help but question its suitability for such a daunting mission.

These ancient sea flowers thrive in Solaris, fostering a harmonious bond with Seabed Snows. Their appearance resembles the decorative feathers often seen on performers' hats during the Carnevale, earning them the nickname "Star's Feather Crown."

The Stygian Phantom, a highly toxic jellyfish cherished by the Fisalia family, stands in stark contrast to Cetus the Tidebreaker. While Cetus is revered for its role in ferrying sailors' souls to the afterlife, the Stygian Phantom is said to deliver lost souls to the Underworld ruled by the Overlord Squid, where they remain trapped for eternity.

Often found alongside the Stygian Phantom, this fish is said to carry the souls of lost sailors who have entered the domain of the Underworld. Fishers hold that these souls are even beyond the reach of Cetus the Tidebreaker, eternally adrift, never to find rest.

During the breeding season, some ocean trenches experience a Seabed Snow population explosion, turning the seabed into a pristine white landscape adorned with vibrant flowers—a truly picturesque sight to behold.
If you ever venture into the depths of the Riccioli waters, beware of any glimmers in the darkness—no matter how enchanting their colors.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. The origin, structure, and power force of this mysterious mechanical device are all shrouded in mystery. Could it hail from a world where humans can be transformed into machines, robots talk, airships dominate the skies, and fish are made of iron? What? You want to know why the oceans there are red?
A dreamy creature found in the ocean trenches, like a cute tiny elf. Its survival hinges on extremely specific conditions, making it impossible to sell as an ornamental pet in Ragunna.

Captain Ahab and Bertoli, a biologist from the Pioneer Association, once had a heated debate over the name of this fish. Ahab insisted that its fondness for sunbathing warranted the name "Sunfish," to which Bertoli retorted, "Then why not just call it 'Dried Flatfish' instead?"

This vibrant red shrimp has an intimidating name, but its flavor tells a different story. Renowned for its exquisite taste, some food enthusiasts believe the name "Legilimens Shrimp" stems from its ability to captivate anyone who takes just one bite.

A top predator in the oceanic waters surrounding the Riccioli Islands, the Lancetfish is known for its fiery temper. Once it sinks its teeth into prey, it never lets go, swallowing its victim whole. This habit has led to frequent catches of Lancetfish that died from attempting to devour a Trombone Ammonoid—shells and all.
Wait, is that... Astrite!? Holy crab!!

This peculiar fish always "stands" on the seabed with its three slender fins. Its primary diet consists of Seabed Snows, but these poor little deep-sea bunnies occasionally try to climb its fins for a counterattack. Alas, their attempts are always in vain.

Painters in Ragunna once tried to extract the vivid hues of the Rainbow Dolphinfish for their artwork but abandoned the idea when the pigments proved impossible to blend. This type of dolphinfish carries its offspring while hunting and is fiercely protective. If its young are threatened, it will retaliate without hesitation, even capsizing fishing ships—hence the nickname "Iron Lady."

As a rare survivor of the last Lament, their shell is revered by the Order of the Deep as a sacred material for crafting instruments. Yet, with natural predators at every turn, their numbers in the Riccioli waters are dwindling rapidly.

A colossal hairtail that can stretch several meters in length, the Reinfish is a legendary creature in the Riccioli Islands. According to local lore, it serves as the reins of the sea god's chariot. In Ragunna, however, its appearance is seen as an omen of an impending earthquake. Like the Lancetfish, the Reinfish reigns as a top predator in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.  Legend has it that this shark only preys on pirates attempting to bury their treasures, devouring them whole along with their gold. Recently, the Aureo Shark has been hunting a notorious pirate named Aldric, who narrowly escaped its jaws—until fate brought it to your fishing boat instead.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. Legend has it that during Napolis the Second's pilgrimage, a storm arose. To calm the tempest, a pink sacred relic was cast into the raging sea, restoring the waters to their former tranquility. An ordinary ray fish happened to pass by the relic and was imbued with its pink hue.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This rare, colossal sea dragon was once believed extinct until it was spotted in the depths of the Riccioli Trench. Locals of the Riccioli Islands believe it to be a guardian of the sea, akin to Cetus the Tidebreaker. In the scriptures of the Order of the Deep, the Pelagic Wrym is deemed a harbinger of the Sentinel's manifestation.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. It is said that after Threnodian Leviathan was defeated by Sentinel Imperator, its subordinates were stripped of their power, left to barely survive in the depths. Draco Cobia, once a loyal servant of the Leviathan, has long lost the power granted by the Threnodian, yet it still remains a deadly predator to smaller sea creatures.

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands.
"In the Underworld palace, the archdemon sits on its throne, awaiting souls delivered by the ferryman. With a thousand grasping arms, it rises to seize the heart of the condemned. From that moment, the wretched soul is bound to serve the archdemon for a thousand years, a fate from which neither Cetus the Tidebreaker nor Imperator can deliver them."

A legendary creature, one of the sovereigns of the marine life in the Riccioli Islands. This creature is a top predator who has survived thousands of years in the oceanic waters of the Riccioli Islands. Surviving the Lament might sound impressive, but facing its razor-sharp fangs is an even greater challenge.

[Whimpering Wastes]
In Whimpering Wastes, your skills will be tested through multiple challenge stages. Completing each stage will earn you points. Earn points to claim corresponding rewards.

[Waters]
Whimpering Wastes features three areas: <color=#c19f51>[Forbidden Waters], [Respawning Waters: Chasm], [Respawning Waters: Torrents]</color>. Complete all challenges within the preceding area to unlock the following.

[Tokens]
In Whimpering Wastes, every team must equip Tokens which grant special effects during combat. Completing a challenge consumes one Token use. Token use can be restored by [Resetting] the challenge.

[Area Effects]
Whimpering Wastes feature special environmental effects and enemies.

[Respawn Cycle]
Rewards for [Forbidden Waters] can only be claimed once. However, <color=#c19f51>the challenges and rewards of [Respawning Waters: Chasm] and [Respawning Waters: Torrents] will reset periodically</color> with varied content and effects. When the cycle resets, your progress will be cleared, and you can challenge again to claim rewards.

[Record Sync]
In the last cycle, provided that you:
-Achieved a result no less than S in Stage 7 and Stage 8 of [Respawning Waters: Chasm].
-Obtained no less than 15,000 points in total in [Respawning Waters: Chasm]. 
-Obtained no less than 4,500 points in [Respawning Waters: Torrents].
Your team lineup and Tokens from the last cycle will be used to automatically clear Stage 7 and Stage 8 in the current cycle of [Respawning Waters: Chasm].
If the tokens used in your last cycle have expired, the record will substitute those expired tokens with unlimited-use tokens of the highest rarity that you've currently unlocked.

[Ember]
You can build up Ember during combat in [Respawning Waters: Chasm] and [Respawning Waters: Torrents]. When the Ember gauge is filled, you'll enter the powerful Burning Waves state.

Fierce Tacet Discords circle the skies, while the remnants of fallen trees scatter the path. The air is thick with the scent of an approaching storm. Only by enduring the thunder and gusting winds can you reach the land of peace.

[Note]

[About]

After a decade of anticipation, the long-awaited Carnevale has reignited a fiery passion that refuses to fade.

The Water City has just unveiled a corner of its secrets. Now is the best time to set sail, ride the winds, and venture into the uncharted corners of this mysterious land.

With the world's curtain lifting, a new exploration calls—why wait? Dive into the adventure now!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 22 and unlock Utility: Flight.

[Event Rules]

1. During the event, you can invite other players to join the Overdash Challenge in Co-op Mode. The first to finish is the winner.

2. Once the first player finishes, the challenge enters a 20-second final sprint phase. After the sprint phase ends, results will be finalized.

3. Combat is disabled during the challenge. Players must follow the markers to finish the challenge.

4. The final points consist of two parts: Course Completion Points and Ranking Points:

I. Course Completion Points are earned by reaching designated checkpoints along the track.

II. Ranking Points are earned based on the order in which players finish.

Touch to collect, or use Grapple to hook and quickly reach the Tapes of Last Words scattered across Lahai-Roi.
Arsenio uses his device to purify their Voidmatter contamination, restoring the voices of the departed as proof of their existence.

Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander Lahai-Roi.
Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Soliseed Plains. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.
A Void Storm leaves annihilation in its wake. In the silence that follows, the faint, spectral frequencies of Voidmatter are the only remaining signs of its passing...

Beneath the Academy lies a series of small printing machines. When a Void Storm causes severe disruption, they deploy Cube Blockers to protect their core components.
After the Void Storm passes, any heavily affected machines require manual reset. Operators must disable the Cube Blockers to restore normal operation.
A remote hot spring warmed by the sun. Let the waters soothe you as you look up and lose yourself in the splendor of the night sky.
Use the Route Constructor to generate a skill-based race track. Pass through all Score Rings to complete the challenge and claim your reward.
Mechascout: Transition is equipped with a customized giant mech arm, powerful enough to launch a person a remarkable distance with a single throw.
A racing challenge track. Complete the course within the required time to earn rewards.

Minna has just bought her very first Terminal, but she doesn't seem to have the faintest idea how to use it...
Find her in Bjartr Woods and lend a hand before she accidentally breaks it.
You've caught the attention of a particularly perceptive Terminal assistant. He claims there exists a race track where no one has ever crossed the finish line...

A melody, once scattered to the winds, is now sought by Soliskin who yearn to hear it whole again. 
Follow them to a place heavy with memory. Work with the Soliskin to restore the lost "music sheet." If the music returns, the story it holds may finally awaken.

Certain areas in Lahai-Roi are rich with Supply Chests.
Use your Sensor and the Owlwatch Scanner on your expedition motorbike to locate them.

The nexus of an ecological information network designed based on the principles of Wutherium Science. Typically situated in medium and large towns, it detects and models energy fluctuations, activities of Tacet Discords, and other abnormal signals to provide early warnings of Waveworn Phenomena.

In the Roya Frostlands and Lahai-Roi, the Resonance Nexus is known as the Solis Lens Array. These lenses concentrate and convert the glow of the Reactor Drive into usable power for local facilities.

As a part of this system, smaller Resonance Beacons log environmental data within their radius and relay it back to the Nexus.

You can fast-travel to any activated Resonance Beacon to restore any injured or downed Resonators.

- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after consuming all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> or <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
Attacking targets with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for {5}s.
The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Every {6} point of <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> consumed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>. Up to {7} points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> and ends <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Fever</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color>.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color> and exits <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa resets <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>.
When in <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Glide</color></size>
When Chisa is not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and has more than {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>, she can consume {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> in the following 5 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> in mid-air before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
- While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> or <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> forward shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing when launched into mid-air.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>.
During the skill, hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ring of Chainsaw</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {9} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Normal Attack </color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> grants <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> grants {11} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Jetstream</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>. 
Chisa continuously obtains <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> over time.
Chisa obtains {13} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> upon defeating a target. 
Exiting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> resets <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> passively for a short period of time after casting  <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Seraphic Duo</color></size>
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> for {1}s. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture</color></size>
When Aemeath is in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore</color></size>
In the Mech form, when in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> on the target for {4}s, stacking up to {3} times.
<size=10></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up to {6} times.
While in combat, when the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on targets near the active Resonator reaches {8} stacks, inflict {9} stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>. If the targets have more than {10} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every {27}s:
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.
<size=10></size>
Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals {11} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against the target is increased by {12}. This effect lasts for {28}s. The target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> stacks on targets if they are inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, and trigger the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target by {13}.
<size=10></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Stardust Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> additionally deal {14} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> on the main target is additionally increased by {15}. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color></size>
Active in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>. Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets within range that are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starflux Thrust</color></size>
When in the Mech form and <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is more than {16}, use the Utility button to cast <color=Highlight>Starflux Thrust</color> and soar in the air by continuously consuming <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color>.

<color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> is capped at {17} points.

1.本游戏是一款开放世界动作类游戏，适用于年满16周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。

2.本游戏基于架空的故事背景和世界观，与真实历史和现实世界均无任何关联。

3.根据国家相关要求，本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，未通过实名认证的用户不可进入游戏；
游戏中部分玩法和道具需要付费。认证为未成年的用户将接受以下管理：未满8周岁的用户不得进行充值；8周岁以上但未满16周岁的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过50元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用户，单次充值金额不得超过100元人民币，每月充值金额累计不得超过400元人民币。
游戏仅会在周五、周六、周日及法定节假日的20时至21时，向未成年人提供1小时游戏服务。

4.游戏中设置了主线及丰富的支线剧情，并且提供了开放世界探索玩法。游戏内有丰富多彩的剧情，精美的游戏画面，优质的游戏配音以及新颖的系统玩法。

[About]
To help Startorch freshmen learn to drive safely, the Biological Mechanical Exoswarm Materials Manufacturing and Research Club developed H.E.R.M.E.S., a motorbike simulator running on heuristic algorithms. But due to some issues with the model's training data, the system accidentally became sentient and refused to be driven. In their last-ditch effort, the developer reached out to you for help with the testing.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and obtain access to the expedition motorbike.

[Event Rules]
Select a Resonator to challenge the tracks with H.E.R.M.E.S. with an arsenal of new weapons. Use enhancement modules to boost the stats of H.E.R.M.E.S. and upgrade their weapons. Complete all tracks to finalize the testing.
Any unclaimed rewards will be reissued via in-game Mail the next time you log in to the game within 30 days after the event ends.
In this event, your progress can be saved after you defeat the boss. The next time you enter, you can continue from where you left off or start a new run.

A pure-white lycoris.
Its petals seem untinted by the vivid scarlet typical of its kind. Or perhaps the colors that were there have long faded. These delicate flowers bloom quietly in darkness. Just like the name they've been given, their unique appearance suggests maybe a whole new world exists beyond the Beyond.
"Things unfinished in this life shall wait for the next."
A material used for Resonator Ascension.
Meat obtained from shrimps, tender and springy. In skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

These pinecones grow slowly under low clusters of needles. Their thick shells can't hide the warm, nutty scent inside. The kernels have a gentle pine-resin sweetness, and once roasted, they release a mellow, toasty aroma, perfect for travelers crossing the frostlands who need quick energy.

The needles of the Creeping Torchpine stand in dense, upright clusters and can survive extreme cold and poor soil. They carry a sharp herbal fragrance and small amounts of frost-resistant oils. Slightly bitter with a clean aftertaste, they're used in medicinal drinks or as a seasoning to add a bright, wintry note to food.

A large berry nourished by the Reactor Drive's light, gleaming with the warm amber glow of dusk. Sweet-tart, juicy, and rich in natural sugars, it is often gathered by Shepherds tending the Exoswarm, who drink its nectar to recover their strength.

Yet once a Dusk Honeypot overripens, it can leave both humans and Exoswarm intoxicated. When a Shepherd fails to return from a foraging trip, chances are they've simply indulged in one too many overripe berries without realizing it.

An ancient fern that thrives in cool, shady spots. Its newly sprouted fronds will curl tightly at the tips, forming tender, fresh fern balls. Naturally dehydrated after being picked, these balls are easy to preserve as compact, long-lasting dried food.

Before eating, simply soak them in snowmelt to rehydrate, and they instantly regain a vibrant, fresh green, as if just harvested. The Roya often thread Fern Spores for grilling or scatter them in shaded areas to grow new ferns. Most Roya have their first taste of Fern Spores in early childhood, though it's rarely a fond memory.

This species of lichen clings to waterside rocks, its existence as ancient as the underground cavern itself, even predating the arrival of the Exostrider. Long before the underground was called Lahai-Roi, this type of lichen had already taken root. Over countless years, it slowly eroded the hard rock, breaking it down into soil capable of nurturing new life.

In Royan mythology, Cradle Lichen symbolizes return and transformation. When burying precious objects, the Roya will weave the lichen into mats, wrapping the treasures before laying them in the earth.
A material used for Weapon and Tool crafting.

After the geological shifts in the Royan Frostlands, some trees were frozen instantly, while others were dragged underground with the moving crust and slowly turned into minerals under long pressure. Their growth rings remain perfectly preserved, providing key clues about how Solaris's climate changed after the Lament.

In Royan stories, Jade Wood stands for time, experience, and wisdom—the embodiment of nature's memories.
A material used for Weapon and Tool crafting.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

A meteorite crashes into the ground, and upon it sprout spores. The fungal network grows, forming a microscopic cosmos of its own.

The Gemini Spores are extraordinarily delicate. One gentle puff and they dissolve into fine spore dust, drifting like a miniature galaxy. Yet they are also incredibly resilient, perhaps harboring faint frequencies of the "old universe." They are the only Lahai-Roi creature capable of surviving in the Voidmatter Zone.

The frequencies of the star clusters have painted them with celestial colors. The Roya use these spores as pigments to record observed galaxies or create predictive petroglyphs of their structures.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

No taller than the knee, fragile against the icy wind, yet it grows year after year in the cracks of frozen rocks. Only at the very instant the polar night ends does it bloom, unfurling clusters of white flowers like delicate snowflakes. The Roya call it Linnaea, meaning "the last trace of tenderness in the blizzard."
A material used for Resonator Ascension.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

For most Roya, their first encounter with "calculation" in childhood wasn't a numeration table from Startorch Academy, but the cross-section of an ancient seashell. These fossilized shells, known as Arithmetic Shells, have natural interiors etched into concentric grooves, like a mathematical grid carved by the hands of the divine. Elders would teach children to drop small stones of varying colors and shapes—or tiny sticks—into the grooves, mimicking the processes of addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, distribution, and pairing…
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

Due to the Exostrider's fragmented frequencies incorporated into these minerals, they have become ideal materials for both Exoswarm restoration and construction. Over the course of history, the Exoswarm has been instinctively collecting Luxite. Some friendly Exoswarm also assist the Spacetrek Collective in harvesting the mineral, providing material for Lahai-Roi's infrastructure.

Beyond its practical uses, certain Luxite deposits possess exceptional optical properties. At specific angles, they refract the Reactor's light in a fixed pattern, allowing observers to determine their position relative to the Reactor Drive. The Roya call these special stones the Eye of Sol.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

A "time capsule" preserving Lahai-Roi's warmer days. Tree resin encased the moss below, holding a fleeting moment in time. When this frozen memory shatters, even paused life may find a chance to begin anew.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

In the harsh frostlands, the carnivorous Edelschnee has developed a unique survival strategy.

At rest, it curls into a fluffy snowball. When it senses a wounded creature nearby, it gently unfurls, wrapping the being in its delicate tendrils to feed. While doing so, it cleans wounds and secretes a mild anesthetic, while its long fibers cover and protect the injury.

Creatures of the frostlands often seek Edelschnee for healing. Once the seed balls mature, they disperse through the environment. Its fluffy fibers are used for textiles and medicine, making Edelschnee an essential resource for the Roya.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

Legend has it that the Waxweavers were once Solsworns, cursed for failing their sacred charge.

Day in and day out, they observe the light. Day in and day out, they weave the light. Their spinning begins with the first rays of dawn and concludes at the hour of twilight when the finished web is retrieved. This endless vigil continues, as if they are still desperately striving to fulfill the duty they abandoned, weaving a web of their own atonement.

For this reason, the Roya maintain a solemn, religious reverence and deep pity for the Waxweavers.

When melted, their silk can be applied to wounds to aid healing, or used as a water-resistant coating.

A metallic shard, resembling a solitary butterfly wing, its surface dull and covered with a dense passivation layer. Under suitable temperature conditions, the residual frequency energy within can still be harnessed.

A metallic shard, resembling a pair of butterfly wings, its surface glimmers like Tacetites. Due to its reactive nature, careful storage is required after collection to prevent loss of its frequency energy.

A triple-winged metallic shard, exhibiting an unusual radiance. This material forms under extremely rare conditions, and its transformation patterns remain largely unexplored by current scientific research.

A solidified metallic shard, resembling a fused cluster of butterfly wings. Microscopic analysis of a few samples reveals their highly intricate internal structure, which appears more like that of a living organism than an inorganic material.
A bullet-shaped metal, named Combustor for its peculiar shape. Specialized purification processes are required as it typically contains a high level of impurities.
Resembling a solidified bullet, this metal has undergone quenching, greatly reducing impurities. Even non-specialists can discern the differences between various grades.

Resembling a bullet, this metal has its impurities almost removed after repeated purification. Beyond its practical applications, its exquisite and unusual form makes it a highly sought-after collectible.
Rsembling a bullet, this metal is virtually flawless in purity. Some Resonators hesitate to use it as Ascension Material, preferring to have it crafted into unique ornaments by skilled artisans.

Intermittent and incomplete, this Resonance Cord contains stored tonal energy that can be extracted by researchers, yet its content remains indecipherable.
Complete and solidified, this Resonance Cord captures the paradox of motion and stillness that fascinates researchers. Its secrets, however, remain unsolved.
Interwoven yet balanced, this Resonance Cord is as harmonious as a song that no one has ever written. Perhaps it is more a subject for aesthetics than science.

The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.

When it ebbs, many Chromeshells will be left on beaches.

A snail with strange wave-like patterns on its shells. Usually spotted after Retroact Rains.
Dripsnail's shell can store the sound waves of specific frequencies, and once the shell is crushed, nearby creatures will hear a sound similar to the rain sound, hence the name.

The Exiles prefer Viola, a plant of great vitality. They cook the young shoots of Viola as a source of vegetable.
Experienced observers can determine the whereabouts of the Exiles by the distribution of Viola.

A blossom on cliffs, swaying to the blowing of breezes.
When the flowers swing in the currents, their light gestures always leave a strong impression.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

Legend has it that a traveler, who delighted in exploring mountains and rivers, stumbled upon this mushroom. Its shape, resembling a person sheltering from rain under an umbrella, inspired the traveler to name it "Umbragricus".
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
A gem-like plant with scarlet, sweet, and juicy fruit, perfect for immediate consumption or sauce making.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
Edodes offers a richer and more tender flavor compared to common mushrooms. Simply boiling Edodes in fresh water with a pinch of salt yields a taste akin to Jinzhou Stew.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

Gloom Slough is commonly found among the ruins of villages or cities, and is named for the glowing light that resembles a candle flame without the heat.
Gloom Cicada's diet is mainly fluorescent plants, and the sloughs they produce are left with the sedimented fluorescent matters from the insects' skin.

A rare flower found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to glow like moonlight in the dark.
"O warriors, should shadow steal the moon, look down, and the Sliverglow Bloom still shines beneath your feet."
Meat obtained from fowls. Freshly cut. Extra tender. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.
Lightweight and soft feathers that are often used in crafting of accessories or toys.
Meat obtained from animals, featuring a clean cut with distinct fat marbling. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

A large butterfly. They are often active in dense vegetation areas in woodlands or other environments. They often fly in pairs at high altitudes and feed on nectar. Hard to capture.
It is the most commonly seen butterflies because of its high reproductive ability and adaptability to the living environment.

Red Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly family. Its overly bright coloration renders it less adaptable to various environments compared to the common Phoenix Butterfly, making it more susceptible to predators. It ranks second in terms of both quantity and rarity among the three butterfly species.

Blue Feather Butterfly is a variant of the heterochrome Phoenix Butterfly. Its genetic mutation gives it a dreamy scale color but also reduces its reproduction ability. As a result, the Blue Feather Butterfly is the rarest and most elusive of the three species.

Chrysopa possesses two pairs of wings made of transparent membranes with delicate reticulate veins resembling leaves.
It primarily preys on small insects and serves as a natural predator for many pests, making it a valuable resource for biological pest control.
Golden-ringed Dragonfly is a wetland and water predator. Its diet includes flying insects and small fish and shrimp. It is known for rapid flying and predating speed.
Meat obtained from fish, featuring a tender cut with a refreshing taste. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living in stone crevices or caves and other dark places. Their skin is covered with leathery scales, and their body has black and white ring-shaped patterns alternately arranged. They most feed on earthworms, snails, and insects.

Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living by waters or in wetlands. Their skin is covered with leathery scales. While their whole body is blue, musclar spines are found on their back. They favor wet, warm environments and small shrimp, crabs for diet.

Carnivorous reptiles, common lizards in grasslands, though occasional sightings in towns exist. They would hide themselves in parterres or plant trellis. However, as they are not poisonous, has a wide diet and a gentle temper, they are sometimes taken as pets by citizens.

A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. Their habitat is often established on lush bushes. When it rains, they often come out to feed on snails and earthworms. Therefore, after rain, Black-Striped Frogs can often be seen crossing the roads in an attempt to return to the waterside.

A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. A heterochrome species of Black-Striped Frog. Since it is relatively scarce and more vulnerable to enemies due to the color, some amphibian fans will catch Goldenback Frogs after rain and take them home as pets.
A specialty mineral with a shape of needle clusters. Sharp and tough. Mostly used in cutting metals or other crystals or making weapons.

A translucent specialty mineral found in the Tiger's Maw Mine. Both the crystal produce and raw status of this mineral has a translucent azure shine. As a material, it has excellent toughness and stability.
A widely distributed mineral. Its unique, profound purple distinguishes itself from other minerals. Due to its fragility, it requires careful processing with specialized equipment.

Minerals formed over time from the remains of dead plants within Tacet Fields that had sunken into its terrains. Due to the retained woody plant-like structural appearances, these minerals were given the name "Floramber", though they are unrelated to ambers in terms of shape or form.
A boost part disassembled from various weapons, featuring impressive versatility. By collecting enough quantity of these parts, you can apply them to enhance the performance of Tacetite Weapons.

A chip with missing content. Therefore, it cannot be directly used to optimize the performance of Echoes. However, by collecting enough quantity of these chips, you can still pick out complete frequencies with similar effects.
A gift from birds, and a regular on dinner tables.
Can be used to increase your Trial Level.
The essence of tribulations endured by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.
Can be used to increase your Trial Level.
Can be used to increase your Glory Level.

When Qiuyuan and his comrades were still in service, their missions often required them to travel fast and eat light, with little chance to enjoy a good meal. Even when they lodged at village inns, they still had to cook their own food out of an abundance of caution. Originally from Chongzhou, Qiuyuan had learned a few basic recipes at a young age. One of his dishes was fragrant, spicy, and mouthwatering, perfect for an empty stomach when paired with rice. Simple, yet satisfying. 
"Eat well, live well."

Galbrena's unique dessert recipe features large scoops of ice cream over a bowl of shaved ice, topped with colorful jams for that extra kick in flavor, along with a portion generous enough to eat to your heart's content. She even took extra care to adjust the Tacet Discord-shaped candies and cookies to be more appealing and cute.
Perhaps there's a deeper reason behind it all: When dealing with Tacet Discords, one needs a sharp, decisive "crunch." But when it comes to life, one should savor its flavors to the fullest. According to Galbrena, eating them separately or together comes down to personal preference. Her only advice is: Enjoy it before it melts. Many life's precious moments "melt in an instant," just like the sprinkles of ice. But don't worry, delightful flavors cling to the taste buds and never fade, always there to enjoy.

An ordinary, traditional bread found throughout Septimont, even in the far-off town of Fabianum. Perhaps to set it apart, local bakers in Fabianum would sprinkle crushed herbs over the crisp crust and, with a sense of ceremony, carve the word "Delicious" into the surface, as if this modest declaration could lend it a hint of dignity.
Is it delicious? The young Augusta never thought so. To her, it was just the dry, hard bread waiting at home after a day of running wild, something to fill her belly, the quiet "footnote" to every dinner her mother made. It was plain, unremarkable. Like water. Like sunlight. So ordinary it was easy to overlook. But years later, standing before her own stove in Septimont, Augusta tried to recapture that long-forgotten taste. And as the familiar scent and gentle sweetness returned to her tongue, she finally understood what "Delicious" meant.
Perhaps, she had never truly bid farewell to her hometown.

Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Somnoire Anchor.

Ever since he turned into a white cat, Ivory Gatekeeper has been dreaming of a grand meal...
It's a shame that he refuses to share any details with anyone.
Used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Somnoire Anchor.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

Golden Thiefbat's talon.
Golden Thiefbats have dexterous claws and like to steal anything that shines. The Thief's Talon is considered a lucky charm in Rinascita.
It is not unusual for a Ragunnesi businessman to put a Thief's Talon in their pocket in the hope of cutting lucrative deals.

Refined animal fat, rich with savory aroma.
In expert hands, it creates a perfectly golden crisp crust, delivering indulgent flavor without a hint of greasiness. 
One bite and your taste buds will be in pure bliss.

Sea Bunny Meat, rich in protein with a tender, succulent texture.
This delicacy requires careful preparation. The Heliobane Fungia, along with other poisonous glands and fluids, must be removed, and the meat cooked to just the right temperature to neutralize any toxins. Whether it becomes a delicious delicacy to die for, or one that costs you your life, depends entirely on the chef's skill.

Thick, soft fur, gentle to the touch, and warming to the very core.
Why strip their coats bare, you ask? Well, haven't you heard of the law of conservation of energy? The warmth hasn't disappeared, it's simply been transferred from them to you.

A species of scarab that resembles a coin in appearance, with a reflective golden exoskeleton.
For Golden Thiefbats, Goldcrest Scarabs are both a pleasant sight and a delicious snack.

A type of poisonous algae that forms a symbiotic relationship with Sea Bunnies. Heliobane Fungia is rich in gelatine, an important ingredient in many desserts.
Gelatin extracted from Heliobane Fungia has a subtle sweetness and gives desserts a silky, springy texture.

A species of crab that makes its home in miniature bells. 
Bell Crabs feed on fish, shrimp, clams, and other small sea creatures. They can scuttle about quickly, emitting a jingling sound as they go. At night, they avoid predators by hiding beneath the decaying hulls of beached boats.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

A creamy resin produced by Nuvola trees, shaped like a cloud and carrying a unique fragrance.
The Nuvola tree is a symbol of healing and renewal. If such a tree is cut, it produces resin to seal the wound until it fully heals. The Ragunnesi call Mastic Nuvola "Healer's Tears."
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

A type of strawflower that grows in clusters. Sunflare Everlasting has pinnate leaves and disk-shaped flowers. Once picked and air-dried, the flowers retain their golden hue, described as "sunlight that never fades."

Legend says the first divine oracle given to Ragunna was carved into a tree trunk, and from the mark, a green branch grew.
The Viscum Berries that sprout from this branch are known as the "Fruit of Wisdom." It is believed that eating them grants spiritual enlightenment.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

An herb with the longest history of use in Rinascita. 
Bay Leaves are used in cooking to give extra flavor to dishes because of their unique aroma, while Cassia Buds are used for their calming properties and to ward off insects. Together, they are revered in Rinascita as the "Sublime Remedy."
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.

The delectable fruit of a wild olive shrub that grows in fertile soil. Felicitous Olives are a favored food for certain animals.
Herders often raise herbivores with a keen sense of smell to help track down these prized olives.
A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

A cluster of golden sulfur crystals, often found in caves rich in geothermal activity. They resemble their mythical namesake—the Golden Fleece guarded by a venomous dragon.
When ground into a fine powder and combined with a hint of molten copper, Golden Fleece transforms into stage-worthy fireworks.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

A tall flower with a firm stem, crowned by delicate flowers.
Sword Acoruses are often used by instructors to teach swordsmanship to young nobles, replacing real swords with these harmless blooms. The children, entranced by the beauty and fragrance, find their attention captured far more easily than by cold, menacing blades.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

A vividly colored flower shaped like an unfurling firework.
Give a Firecracker Jewelweed a gentle shake, and its swollen capsules will burst open...
The seeds scatter in all directions, resembling the colorful burst of a firecracker.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

A fluorescent flower often found in the crevices of ruins. In the past, Seaside Cendrelis wreaths were used in the rite of initiation for infants and the inaugurations of new Fisalia family heads. As a result, it became a symbol of the power once held by the old nobility.
Ever since the tower's fateful ascent to the sky, the Seaside Cendrelis has been considered extinct, for it has never been seen again.
A material used for Resonator Ascension.

A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.
The origins of Resonant Calcite are still debated. Some believe its unique properties come from prolonged exposure to the flow of frequencies in Nimbus Sanctum, while others argue that these frequencies seeped into geological fissures, where they influenced the mineral's formation.

A versatile, bronzed iron ore often mistaken for gold, though it's not hard to tell the difference upon closer inspection.
In the past, con artists would craft Fool's Gold into jewelry and sell it as real gold.
Though such tricks are long obsolete, the name "Fool's Gold" endures to this day.

A potion that can slightly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. It is especially beneficial for Resonators struggling with mastering their Fortes, as it greatly enhances adaptability. However, when consumed by Resonators who already exhibit excellent control over their Fortes, its effectiveness is somewhat diminished due to its fully diluted nature.

A potion that can further enhance the user's frequency perception ability. By adjusting the mixture ratio, this potion is more suitable for Resonators with relatively good control over their Fortes. With a near-perfect cost-effectiveness, it is regarded as flawless except for its "notoriously" bland taste.

A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys high popularity among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.

A potion that can significantly enhance the user's Frequency perception. Its formula is locked within a vault with the highest security. Rumor has it the inventor of this potion is a powerful Resonator in their own right, and their hope is to groom a successor capable of surpassing their achievements.
Purified liquid energy extracted from Tacetite, its purity increasing with higher ratings. When injected into a weapon, it offers a corresponding bonus.

A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used to recharge the core modules of Tacetite Weapons. Routine preventative maintenance of weapons is advised for all Resonators, or they may find themselves caught off guard in the case of an emergency.

A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used in the core modules of Tacetite Weapons to increase power output. Weapons are the allies of Resonators and Tacetites serve as their food. Only by nourishing weapons well can they be handier and more powerful in battles.

A supplement storing high-density Tacetite Energy, fully capable of powering most Tacetite Weapons. Experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat this supplement to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.
A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.

A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been greatly diminished. Its surface appears lackluster, covered with a dense layer of passivation film. However, under suitable temperatures, the residual Frequency Energy within it can still be utilized.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.

A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been partially retained. Its surface presents a luster similar to that of Tacetites. As it is quite reactive, it needs to be stored properly upon collection to prevent any loss of Frequency Energy.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.

A fluid metallic drip with high activity. Its surface presents an amazing luster. This polarized matter only forms under extremely strict conditions, and the scientific world has yet to fully figure out its transformation patter.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.

A special fluid metallic drip which can barely form naturally. It maintains a perpetual flow on its surface. Microscopic examinations of a few samples have revealed its intricate inner structure, resembling more of a living organism than an inorganic substance.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.

A crystal shaped like a solidified flame. Its unconventional appearance challenges Old Science. Typically, it contains a rather high level of impurities and thus requires specialized purification treatment for practical use.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.

A crystal shaped like a solidified candle flame. Its impurities are significantly reduced through a rough extraction and recrystallization process. This makes it simple even for those without expertise to distinguish between crystals of varying quality.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.

A crystal shaped like a solidified firework. After repeated purification, it is almost free of impurities. Its eye-catching and magnificent appearance not only holds practical utility but also elevates its collectible value.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.

A crystal shaped like a raging flame, known for its impeccable purity. As a result, some Resonators don't want to use these crystals solely for enhancement, instead opting to entrust professional craftsmen to process them into unique accessories.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
A helix with soothing waveforms. Facing this remarkable substance, human beings finally realize what static vibration is about.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.

A helix with gentle waveforms. Researchers can extract and utilize the sealed Cadence Energy within it. However, it is worth mentioning that researchers cannot effectively analyze the content contained within this helix.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
A helix with graceful waveforms, like a melodious song composed by nature. Instead of being studied by scientists, it might in essence be a subject best explored by researchers of aesthetics.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
A helix with intense waveforms. Researchers are greatly captivated by the perfect harmony of movement and stillness it displays. However, to this day, no one knows how this harmony is formed.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. However, the inner balance has been disturbed, causing the Remnant within the inner core to reduce to the Reverberation.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is not in a state of decline. By selecting an appropriate absorber, users may still have the chance to extract Remnant Energy.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It maintains a delicate balance. When it is highly concentrated in a centrifuge, it produces products that have various applications.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.

A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is known for its astonishing balance. Due to its indispensable role in many high-tech fields, it is subject to the most stringent trade restrictions.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A basic material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.

An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant seed. If you listen carefully, you can feel a pulse-like rhythm. However, in fact, this substance is not alive, and its structure is pretty similar to that of the Tacet Core of a Howler.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant bud. If you listen carefully, you can sense the pleasure of sprouting from the ground. However, it can never grow into a complete plant.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
An advanced material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.

An unusual substance resembling the shape of a new leaf. If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint rustle of it bathing in sunlight and sucking dew. In fact, it is able to absorb the wandering Frequency Energy from the environment.
A material used for Weapon Ascension.
A premium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
An unusual substance resembling the shape of a blossom. If you listen carefully, you can hear the petals unfolding. At the end of the silent time, a blossom of Cadence finally bursts into bloom.

"He bent down and picked up the box, salvaged from the wreckage. Its surface, stained with blood, radiated a strange, captivating glow. This eerie luster seemed to beckon him, drawing him away from the tragic aftermath of the crew's violent fights. Without a glance back, he vanished into the depths of the island."

The traveler clung to the belief that the blood flowing through his veins was tied to a lineage from a land long forgotten by Rinascita. The visions of cold and fjords relentlessly plagued his mind. Finally, he poured all his savings into a ship, set sail, and never returned.

"Mary, by the time you read this letter, everything will have already settled. Do not mourn for me. I have given my life willingly, alongside my comrades, to defend the glory of the Sentinel. We will ascend to the heavens and stand beside Them."

He continued to roll the dice, silently praying that he wouldn't be forced to face the fate head-on. Yet, deep down, he understood that by continuing to roll, he had already made his choice. He was prepared to bring it all to an end.

The red wasteland lay silent, like a seabed after the tide had withdrawn. The wind lingered, echoing endlessly across the surface. If Fa recalls correctly, this was where they first met Matthew. He was holding that strange object in his hands, which, with a single gentle pluck, let sound bloom into the night, bright and tender. It was here that the Soliskin learned how to enjoy music for the first time, and the photo quietly preserved that moment of first encounter.

Water cascaded down the rock face, scattering into a fine mist that shimmered softly in the air. If Fa recalls correctly, they practiced playing the music here again and again with Matthew. When they finally succeeded, the melody carried them forward like flowing water. The color of "Mi" softened into green, and the photograph retained the memory of wind and water entwined, a light that still trembles gently, like dew on a blade of grass.

A massive metal ring caught the light, its curves reflecting a warm, muted glow. Beyond it, the plains stood in silence. If Fa recalls correctly, it was here that Matthew taught them to recover the beat with their own steps. The bass drifted like the wind across open ground, rhythm lighting up within the Soliskin themselves. The photo preserves that moment when rhythm was rejoined, a faint tremor lingering in the sunlight.

Beginning, climax, finale... red, yellow, and green marks rest quietly in order, forming a complete score. These colors once drifted separately, carried by wind, water, and light. until they return to a single melody. It is a song they completed together. And it remains, even now, a gentle echo that the Soliskin still remember.

Frostwort has a structure remarkably similar to neural tissue. Over millennia of independent evolution, it has gained the ability to transmit simple signals through its symbiotic network, helping it grow efficiently and repair itself.

The Roya dry Frostwort and use it to brew drinks, though it is reserved only for adults.

Foxtail Kelp is entirely edible. Its long, fragile stems often break off and drift to the shore, looking like lost walking sticks or pipes.

The Roya call it the "Traveler’s Staff." For lost travelers trapped in caves, it can serve as a reliable source of food until they reach safety. Children also play with the stems, sparring with one another to see whose kelp lasts the longest.

Meteoric Iron is naturally magnetic and often paired with Sunstone to guide herders through snowstorms. Its excellent heat conductivity also makes cookware crafted from it highly prized, reducing cooking time while adding unique flavors.

Within the iron are dense gems formed under immense pressure when it fell, known as Star Marks among the Roya. They are extremely hard and valuable outside Lahai-Roi. Some have been caught defying Royan rules to extract and trade them.

Red bean pudding that can be easily made at home, a simple homemade dessert. After Hiyuki tweaked the recipe, it now comes in a more convenient package.
Hiyuki doesn't have much of a sweet tooth, but once she became the miko, she quietly visited a dessert shop to learn how to make red bean puddings. 
The children of Ashinohara came to call it the "good luck pudding." However the story grew, the sweetness itself stayed simple. Almost plain.
Just as she hoped.

Denia's dessert from a cooking class. She spent most of the session taste-testing, so in the end she went with jam, something easy to prep.
The result was extremely sweet, under-marinated, and overcooked. The texture and sweetness never quite came together. But it looked creative and photographed well, so her classmates still gave it decent scores—by a slim margin.
"It tastes sweet. It looks nice. That's good enough, right? Hm? Texture and flavor? Sorry, not really following you."

From darkness she seizes power, layering sins upon herself. To hunt. To kill. To deliver a relentless and fatal blow to all evil.
From the light she falls, with her vows etched in her mind. For the deceased. For the living. For her pistols' true targets.

By what means do all things endure? By light and heat, by matter and word, by the mechanics of converging chances, by the soft dissolution into silence, by a moment that mimics the eternal... All things rise and fall in endless rhythm, each bearing its meaning. As for hers, it lies here within her grasp.

The Exclusive ROM for Ciaccona.
All things exist within the lines of poetry. Every sound has its meters and rhymes.
The forest's melodies ascend in spirals toward the moon's silvered grace, harmonized by the nightingales' chorus. When the final note falls and vanishes into the silent earth, a flawless chord echoes endlessly in the depths of this boundless realm.

The Exclusive ROM for Augusta.
Thunder shall purge her pain and weakness. From the crucible of blood and sand, the Sun rises. Not dimmed by dust, but ablaze in her full radiance.

The Exclusive ROM for Chisa.
A crimson thread emerges in the void, as if binding the structures of all things onto a single thread.
At her fingertips, the endless season is drawn taut, snipped, and rewoven, until the scattered path at last converges once more upon this timeline.

The Exclusive ROM for Mornye.
Every pattern can be observed. Every phenomenon can be understood.
The ideal may lie light-years away, yet the path toward it rests within her own hands.

The Exclusive ROM for Lynae.
Prismatic light dances at her fingertips, arcs of color carving radiant trails.
Every rushing hue converges upon her aim, and at last, she reaches a sky where nothing lies beyond her sight.

The Exclusive ROM for Denia.
Dream dissolves like foam, leaving only a silent white dwarf.
Yet the light that once swept the cosmos remains.
She waits in quiescence until her borrowed light finds its way back to the main sequence star.

The Exclusive ROM for Luuk Herssen.
Those are not ridges of the mountains, but the spine of the earth, carrying the night. They protrude from the abdomen of darkness. From the incision spills the light of new life.
Your shadow was nailed to the dying night. With the breaking dawn, your flesh shall rise.
Let it knock open every door of denial.

The Exclusive ROM for Aemeath.
As you drift across the hushed sea of stars, stardust scatters beside you as time crumbles in your wake. All that remains is the unyielding loneliness, warped, diluted, and remade into the plumes of your wings.
The universe sends you on a tribulation of silence, yet you travel on, repaying in radiance.

The Exclusive ROM for Sigrika.
Sunlight gathers. The answer is made plain.
What must be done awaits. The Rein is in your hand.
Step forward, toward the sunlit end.

The Exclusive ROM for Hiyuki.
How keen a blade it takes to impale this unrelenting night?
She presses ever forward for the answer, those unbound wishes roaring in her veins.
